docs.text: Class List Here are the classes, structs, unions and interfaces with brief descriptions: namespace ernie Planetary digital elevation models, as the PDS archives them, and the local heightfields Ernie's Terrain draws of them. struct AnimationPose A SkelAnimation 's samples interpolated at a time: empty arrays for those it lacks. class Atmosphere A planet's atmosphere from a physical model ( EarthAtmosphere , MarsAtmosphere ): its gases and aerosols scatter and absorb the sun's light on its way to the ground, the sun's DistantLight then giving the irradiance above the atmosphere. struct AtmosphereModel A spherical shell of constituents around a planet of radius bottomRadius , up to bottomRadius + topAltitude . struct AtmosphereParams A planet's atmosphere ( AtmosphereParamsOf ): the physical model's settings and where the planet lies. class AttributeDef One declared attribute of a prim type. struct AttributeMeta How an attribute is described and edited. struct AttributeTraits How the declared C++ type T reads, writes and converts: Read with the fallback (accepting any numeric or vector type an author used, as GetNumber does), Write , and From , a value as T or nullopt when it cannot be one. struct AttributeTraits< OrArray< T > > struct AttributeTraits< Path > struct AttributeTraits< Tensor > Bulk data: reads the written tensor or null (there is no fallback), writes with Scene::Write . struct AttributeTraits< bool > struct AttributeTraits< double > struct AttributeTraits< glm::dmat4 > struct AttributeTraits< glm::dquat > struct AttributeTraits< glm::dvec2 > struct AttributeTraits< glm::dvec3 > struct AttributeTraits< glm::dvec4 > struct AttributeTraits< int > struct AttributeTraits< std::string > struct AttributeTraits< std::vector< Path > > struct AttributeTraits< std::vector< float > > struct AttributeTraits< std::vector< std::string > > class AxisShape An implicit shape centred on its origin along one of its axes: a cylinder, cone, capsule or plane. struct BakeOptions How BakeTexture stores a texture. struct BandedAtmosphere An atmosphere averaged over a camera's spectral bands, ready for rendering. struct Refraction A refracted ray traced from radius r (m) at the apparent zenith cosine mu out of the atmosphere, through its spherically layered refractive index ( RefractiveIndex ), by the ray equation d(n t)/ds = grad n with steps of at most step m. struct BandedConstituent A constituent averaged over a camera's spectral bands. class BindlessHeap Every pass's textures and samplers in one descriptor set (set 1 of every PipelineLayout ), each at an index shaders take from their uniforms: bindless descriptor indexing, so a pass's long-lived textures cost it no binding of its own (bindless.slang declares the arrays). class Slot A slot of the heap, freed when destroyed; move-only. class BlendShape Offsets of a mesh's points (and normals), weighted by an animation, with inbetween shapes at weights between 0 and 1. class BlockEncoder Encodes RGBA8 images into BC blocks away from the CPU, as GpuBlockEncoder does on the GPU: bakes use it for the formats it encodes, the CPU's encoders for the rest. class Boundable What has local bounds: geometry and instancers, with an optional authored extent. class BoundableLight An area light (sphere, rect, disk): a radiant power, or a photometric power or illuminance. struct BrdfModel A reflectance model: shader source plus parameter metadata. struct BrdfParam One scalar parameter of a reflectance model, with what a UI needs to edit it. class BrdfRegistry Reflectance models available to a renderer, keyed by BrdfModel::id . class CacheKey A cache's 128-bit key for everything an entry depends on: two 64-bit FNV-1a hashes from different starts, each piece length-prefixed. struct CahvoreModel A camera calibrated in JPL's CAHV family of models, as Mars rovers' cameras are (their PDS labels' GEOMETRIC_CAMERA_MODEL, JPL's camera model files): CAHV, a linear (pinhole) model; CAHVOR, with radial distortion about an optical axis; and CAHVORE, with a fish-eye term and an entrance pupil that moves along the optical axis with the field angle, so its rays do not meet at one point. struct ErnieCamera The model as Ernie renders it, in the model's frame (camera to frame). struct Ray A projection ray: its origin (C, or for CAHVORE the entrance pupil's position for its field angle) and unit direction. class Camera A camera looking down its -z axis with +y up: UsdGeomCamera's projection, apertures, clipping, exposure and shutter, and Ernie's lens, scan, spectral sampling, sensor and view poses. struct CameraParams A camera's parameters resolved from its Camera prim ( CameraParamsOf ): a physically based pinhole camera for one image, with UsdGeomCamera's pose, projection and exposure attributes, a spectral range, a lens and a sensor. struct CameraView The raster view of a camera for one frame, derived from a CameraParams by CameraParams::RasterView : what the rasterizer's passes need. class Capsule A cylinder with hemispherical caps along its axis. struct Change A prim's changes since a consumer last looked. struct ChangeCursor A consumer's position in a scene's history; see Scene::Changes . class ChunkedFrameImages The images of a frame of a batch of views that do not fit one set of images (such as more views than an image has layers): consecutive chunks of the views, each its own FrameImages . class CloudLayersField Ernie's procedural cloud layers: up to four layers over a repeating weather map, carved from tileable noise at each sample on the GPU (three-geospatial's clouds, after Horizon Zero Dawn's), in the field's frame with z up; a Volume 's density, its material's density scaling it. struct CloudLayersParams A field a volume shades with ( VolumesOf ): a grid of a NanoVDB file, an OpenVDBAsset 's, or of a NanoVDBField 's array ( buffer ). struct CloudNoise The tileable noise textures procedural cloud layers are carved from (volume.slang's cloudLayersDensity ): a Perlin-Worley shape and a Worley detail, each repeating in all three axes, a local weather map of the layers' coverage and a curl-noise turbulence, both repeating across. struct CloudTransportOptions struct CloudTransportShape The canonical transport table's lattice. struct CloudTransportTable Light transport in a plane-parallel slab of cloud lit from above by a distant source, for each set of scattering orders (2 and more): the radiance at a view point inside it in each direction of travel, and where on the lit face that light entered, its collector. struct ColorPrimvar The colours a material's diffuse colour reads through a UsdPrimvarReader_float or _float3: the mesh primvar ( primvars:<name> ), one value or three each ( width ), and the reader's fallback where a mesh has none. class Column One attribute of many prims as rows of one array, as a simulation keeps its bodies' poses: written whole from any array (CPU or CUDA, DLPack, no copy), or mapped and written in place on the device asked for, each write one change ( ColumnChange ) whatever the number of prims. struct ColumnChange One attribute of many prims written whole as rows of one tensor ( Scene::Write of a PrimSet again, or Scene::Unmap of it) since a cursor, as Scene::Changes reports it to a consumer that takes the rows whole. class ColumnStorage Storage a consumer of columns offers for them on a device it reads them on, such as a renderer's interop buffers: a column mapped there ( Column::Map ) is then written where the consumer reads it, copying nothing. struct Rows Rows a consumer offers, and whether they are storage it keeps (mapped again, the same rows) rather than a copy made there for now. struct ComputeArrayView A Vulkan image seen by a compute API in place, as an opaque array handle (a CUarray for CUDA, a hipArray_t for HIP): read it with that API's texture or surface objects or 2D array copies. class ComputeInterop Zero-copy sharing between a Vulkan device and the compute device behind it (CUDA or HIP), so arrays from compute frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, CuPy, Warp, simulators) reach Ernie's buffers, and Ernie's results reach them, without passing through host memory. class ComputePipeline A compute pipeline over a PipelineLayout . class Cone A capped cone along its axis, its apex at +height / 2. struct Connection The source of a UsdShade connection: a Shader prim and one of its outputs, e.g. struct Constituent One constituent of an atmosphere: numberDensity particles per m^3 where its profile is 1. class Cube A box centred on its origin, size along each axis. class CubeSphereLod CDLOD terrain over a whole planet: six LodQuadtree height pyramids, one per face of a cube projected onto a sphere of radius Radius() (a quadrilateralized or "cubed" sphere). struct CubeSphereRegion Region of space holding one node of a CubeSphereLod : every direction within angle of axis , between radii inner and outer from the body's centre. class CudaInterop ComputeInterop for the CUDA device behind a Vulkan device. class Cylinder A capped cylinder along its axis. class CylinderLight A cylinder along its x axis emitting from its side as a Lambertian emitter, not its caps. struct CylindricalDem A planet's radius on an equirectangular grid, as LOLA's LDEM products (simple cylindrical, true at the equator) and LROC's NAC DTMs (true at a standard parallel) hold it: heights (metres above referenceRadius ; NaN where the product has no data) row by row from the northern, each row from the western sample eastwards, pixelsPerDegree along the meridians and that times cos(standardParallel) along the parallels. class DenseField Ernie's field of a dense array of values, such as a grid solver's smoke or dust each step (Warp's arrays): sampled as a NanoVDB grid of every voxel, which a device array fills in place on the GPU. struct DenseNanoVdbLayout Where a DenseNanoVdbTopology 's values go: leaf (a, b, c) of leaves (the shape's 8^3 blocks) starts firstLeaf + ((a leaves.y + b) leaves.z + c) leafBytes into the grid, and voxel (i, j, k)'s float is valuesOffset + 4 ((i & 7) 64 + (j & 7) 8 + (k & 7)) bytes into its leaf. struct DensityLayer One term of a vertical density profile, relative to the profile's reference density. struct DensityProfile A vertical density profile: the weighted mean of its layers, so 1 at the ground for exponential and double exponential layers. struct DescriptorBinding One binding of a pipeline's push-descriptor set (set 0). struct DescriptorResource What a binding points at when descriptors are pushed. struct DetailSettings Tiling of the detail albedo and normal textures. struct Device class DiskLight A disk in its xy plane emitting along -z. class DistantLight A light at infinity shining along the -z axis of its transform, such as the Sun. struct DiurnalTable Diurnal surface temperatures over latitude, local time, thermal inertia and albedo: PANGU's planetary look-up tables. struct DomeDirection One of a dome map's regions of about equal energy ( DomeDirectionsOf ), in the map's frame. class DomeLight Light from every direction, optionally from a latitude-longitude map. struct DomeParams An environment light at infinity (UsdLux DomeLight ) resolved for a frame ( DomeParamsOf ): radiance from every direction, the spectrum radiance (W m^-2 sr^-1 nm^-1 per camera band) times a relative RGB map whose cosine-convolved spherical harmonics are sh . struct DomeSun A sun found in a dome's map ( ExtractDomeSun ), in the map's frame. struct DomeSunExtraction The sun of a latitude-longitude dome map ( tokens::kLightTexture layout) and the map without it, for lighting the sun as a shadowed distant light while the dome keeps the rest of the sky. struct DropletPhaseTable The phase function of a cloud's water droplets in each of a frame's bands, for volumes to read (volume.slang's dropletAt ): Mie scattering by a gamma distribution of droplet radii, its narrow forward peak (within kDropletForwardDegrees ) folded into the extinction as unscattered light. struct EarthAtmosphereOptions Earth's atmosphere: an isothermal dry-air column, ozone in a tent profile and a haze aerosol. class EditHistory Undo and redo for scene edits made through it: attribute sets and clears, prims defined, and prims removed with their descendants. class FieldAsset A field read from a file (UsdVol's FieldAsset ). class FieldBase A field of values over space, which Volumes name; its transform places the field in its Volume (UsdVol's FieldBase ). struct FieldWriteTarget Where a DenseField 's writer ( RenderDelegate::SetFieldWriter ) writes this frame: its (x, y, z) float32 values, z fastest, at device address values , which is offset bytes into buffer (for copies), shape of them. struct FrameId Where an image sits in the deterministic random streams of sampling.h . class FrameImages The images a backend renders one frame of a render product into, by render var name: what RenderVarOutput reads, whatever the backend. struct LinearVar A render var the frame holds as one linear buffer over every view rather than an image: written by the frame's own submission, in memory a compute API views in place ( BufferMemory::Shared ), texels of format view after view. struct FrameParams Per-frame parameters of a render, whatever the backend: the camera, the lights, the sensor filters and the frame's place in the random streams. struct SensorChain Several sensor chains over the one raster image, each writing its own vars (render vars with their own ernie:filters ); empty runs filters for vars . class FrameUploads Host data bound for device buffers, staged for one frame in flight and copied by that frame's own commands ( Record ), so the host can prepare a frame while the device still runs earlier ones that read the same buffers: the copies wait on the device for that earlier work, in queue order, rather than the host waiting for it. struct Frustum Six world-space clip planes of a view-projection matrix, for culling axis-aligned boxes. class Gprim Geometry: drawn in a display colour, or with a bound material. class GpuBuffer A Vulkan buffer with its memory, allocated through VMA. class GpuImage A device-local Vulkan image with a view of all its mips and layers, allocated through VMA. class GpuTimer Times GPU zones ( ERNIE_GPU_ZONE ) for Ernie's profiler ( ernie/util/profiler.h ) with timestamp queries: a zone writes one timestamp where it starts and one where it ends in its command buffer, and Collect hands finished zones to the profiler without waiting for the device, then frees their queries by host reset (Vulkan 1.2's hostQueryReset) some collects later, once their submission has surely completed. struct GpuXform A prim posed on the GPU: its transform ops are rows of GPU arrays, one row per prim of one Scene::Write of many paths, so a renderer composes its local transform per instance from the arrays whole, as a PointInstancer 's: translate, then orient, then scale. class GradientNoise Perlin's improved gradient noise in three dimensions, its lattice shuffled by a seed, for procedural fields such as volumes' density: smooth, zero at every integer point, and within about [-1, 1]. class GraphicsPipeline A graphics pipeline for dynamic rendering, with dynamic viewport and scissor and no culling. struct GraphicsPipelineDesc Shaders and fixed-function state of a graphics pipeline that draws triangle lists without vertex buffers. class GroundPlane Ernie: an infinite horizontal floor facing +z at a world height, drawn with its material, optionally as a checkerboard. struct IesProfile A luminaire's photometric profile from an IES LM-63 file: its luminous intensity in candela over its file's angles ( IesType ), which Sample reads in any direction. struct IesTilt An IES file's tilt data (TILT=INCLUDE, or a tilt file): how its lamp's output changes as the luminaire tilts, for lamps whose output depends on their burning position (metal halide). struct Image RGBA image with linear float channels, rows top to bottom. struct ImageDesc Description of a 2D image or 2D image array. class Imageable What every prim has: visibility and the world it is in. struct InstanceData Per-instance arrays of a point instancer, as UsdGeomPointInstancer defines them. class IsdCameraModel What usgscsm's camera models of image support data share, in the body-fixed frame in metres: struct FrameView A frame of the detector as Ernie renders it: a frame camera of the image's samples by its rows, posed ( camera.transform , camera to body-fixed world) when the frame is exposed, the lens's distortion fitted as Brown-Conrady terms (and scale). class IsdFrame A frame camera from its image support data, its geometry as usgscsm's frame model ( UsgsAstroFrameSensorModel ) computes it ( IsdCameraModel ): the whole image is exposed at once, at the ISD's centre time, from one position and orientation. class IsdLineScanner A line scanner (pushbroom camera) from its image support data, its geometry as usgscsm's line scanner model ( UsgsAstroLsSensorModel ) computes it ( IsdCameraModel ): line l is exposed around its time ImageTime(l) , a rate's start time plus its seconds per line times (l - its start line + 0.5), through detector line 0. struct Strip A strip of lines image lines from firstLine as Ernie renders it: a pushbroom camera ( CameraParams::pushbroom ) whose rows are those lines, posed from at the strip's first line's start and to at its end (camera to body-fixed world). class IsdPushFrame A push-frame camera (LROC's WAC, MRO's MARCI) from its image support data, its geometry as usgscsm's push-frame model ( UsgsAstroPushFrameSensorModel ) computes it ( IsdCameraModel ): the image is a stack of framelets, each a frame of FrameletLines lines exposed at once. struct Framelet Framelet __ framelet (in image order, from the top) as Ernie renders it: a frame camera of the image's samples by FrameletLines lines, posed when it is exposed (camera to body-fixed world), its exposure the ISD's, the lens's distortion fitted as Brown-Conrady terms (and scale). struct IsdRotation A rotation sampled over time between two NAIF frames, as ALE reads it ( ale::Orientations ): quaternions (w, x, y, z, scalar first) of the time-dependent rotation of vectors from the reference frame into the first of timeDependentFrames , and a constant rotation (row-major, applied to vectors after it) on into the first of constantFrames . struct IsdSamples States sampled over time: ephemeris times (seconds past J2000, TDB) and a value at each. struct IsdSensor A camera's image support data (ISD) in the Community Sensor Model's JSON form, as ALE (the USGS Abstraction Layer for Ephemerides) writes it from SPICE kernels for planetary cameras such as LRO's NAC and WAC, MRO's CTX and HiRISE: the image's size and timing, the focal plane's map to detector pixels, the optics, and the spacecraft's and the body's states over the image. struct JointDualQuaternion A joint's transform as a unit dual quaternion (rotation, then translation) after a 3 by 3 of its scale and shear. class LaserLight A laser (Ernie): a Gaussian beam of one spectral line along its -z axis, its waist, divergence and power as a datasheet gives them (ISO 11146). struct LatLongGrid Where a raster in simple cylindrical (equirectangular) projection lies: degrees east of its west edge and north of its north edge, and degrees per pixel across and down (positive). struct LensModel A lens: its projection, natural vignetting and transmission. struct LensRayTable A lens given as its rays: unit directions in the camera's frame at every step th sensor pixel corner, ( width / step + 1) by ( height / step + 1) of them row by row from the top left, interpolated between. class Light Any light: UsdLux's LightAPI inputs, its spectrum's shape and Ernie's physical spectrum. struct LightParams A light, resolved for a frame from its prim ( LightParamsOf ). struct Beam A laser's Gaussian beam (Siegman 1986): its 1/e^2 radius at the waist along the light's x and y, its Rayleigh range along each, and the waist's distance along the beam from position , m. struct Lit One frame of its sequence lit during a span of time, and how much: the light's mean over the span relative to its average power. struct Pose Where a light is: its position , direction and tangent . struct LightPatternImage A laser's pattern image ( ernie:laser:pattern:image ) as patterns read it: one linear channel, the mean of its colour channels, its rows top to bottom, and its mip levels after it down to 1 x 1, each max(1, size >> n) on a side and averaging the texels above. struct LightPatternModel A laser's pattern written in Slang: the relative power a laser sends towards each direction, its watts, beam and shadows staying Ernie's. struct LightPatternParam One parameter of a light pattern, which a LaserLight gives in ernie:laser:pattern:params in this order. class LightPatternRegistry Light patterns a renderer can draw, by LightPatternModel::id . struct LinkCollection One of a light's collections (UsdCollectionAPI with its prims expanded): the whole scene when includeRoot , else nothing, then the prims listed and their descendants in or out, the nearest listed ancestor of a prim deciding. struct LinkGroups Geometry grouped by the lights that light it and whose shadows it casts, as the rasterizer applies links: each surface carries its group (0, lit and shadowed by every light, for prims no link singles out), and each light a mask of the groups it lights and of those that cast its shadows. struct LocalTerrain A heightfield of a DEM about one point, in a local frame there: x east, y north and z up, its origin on the reference sphere at the point. struct LodPatch One square patch of PatchCells() x PatchCells() grid quads whose vertices are 2^level raster cells apart. class LodQuadtree Quadtree over a heightfield for continuous distance-dependent level of detail (CDLOD). struct LodRange Distances from the LOD eye, in world units, over which one level's vertices morph towards the next coarser level's. struct LogNormalMode One mode of a log-normal particle size distribution: the number of particles per unit ln(r) is Gaussian with median radius medianRadius (m) and standard deviation sigma , and the mode holds relativeNumber particles relative to the other modes. class MappedFile A file mapped read-only into memory: its bytes are read from disk as they are first touched, so a file far larger than memory can be read in parts, the operating system keeping what is used. struct MappedRenderVar A mapped render var: a tensor for Cpu and Gpu , a compute array for GpuArray . struct MarsAtmosphereOptions Mars's atmosphere: an isothermal CO2 column and suspended dust. class Material How a surface reflects light: Ernie's own inputs, or a UsdPreviewSurface its outputs:surface connects to. struct MaterialSettings How a surface reflects light: a material's settings. struct MaterialXShader A MaterialX surface's shading as Slang for Ernie's shading pass: void ernieMaterialX(out float3 color, out float3 transparency) , which evaluates its graph for the pixel being shaded through the functions below (which the shading pass defines before it), with MaterialX's own closures and nodes: struct MaterialXSource A Material 's MaterialX surface as a document. struct MaterialXTexture A texture a MaterialX shader samples, by its slot in the material's texture table. struct MaterialXUniform A value a MaterialX shader reads from its material's uniform buffer. struct MeasuredReflectance A measured reflectance spectrum Ernie embeds: its id (as a material names it in ernie:reflectance:library ), what was measured, the ECOSTRESS file it comes from, and the spectrum, a fraction from 350 nm (or where its measurement starts) to 2.5 um and for most on into the thermal infrared, 12.5 to 15 um. class Mesh A polygon mesh: points and the faces over them. struct MeshData Triangle mesh geometry in a mesh's own frame. struct Level A coarser level of detail: count entries of lodIndices from first , at most error (in mesh units) from the full mesh. struct MeshDataOptions The geometry of the Mesh prim at mesh : points , faceVertexCounts and faceVertexIndices (triangulated as fans), per-vertex normals , and per-vertex primvars:displayColor when it has one colour per point. struct MeshWriteTarget Where a mesh's writer ( RenderDelegate::SetMeshWriter ) writes this frame: device addresses into the renderer's own buffers, which a shader reads and writes as pointers (Slang's float* ). struct MieEfficiencies Mie efficiencies of a homogeneous sphere: cross sections over the geometric cross section pi r^2, and the asymmetry parameter g (the mean cosine of the scattering angle). class MosaicRaster One raster of a grid of tiles of one size, type and channels, columns to a row, rows top to bottom: a global mosaic too large for one file (Blue Marble's eight 21600 x 21600 tiles). struct NamedCahvore A named camera model in a frame, as camera model files list them. class NanoVDBField Ernie's field of NanoVDB grids written as an array instead of a file, such as a simulation's each step (Warp's Volume.array() ): one of its grids, read as an OpenVDBAsset 's. struct NanoVdbGrid One sparse grid as NanoVDB lays it out: a buffer the GPU reads in place (PNanoVDB's tree walk), and what Ernie needs of its header. class NonboundableLight A light at infinity (distant, dome), whose photometric brightness is an illuminance. struct NormalEquations Accumulates the normal equations of a linear least-squares fit, row by row. class OffscreenTarget A colour and depth target for headless rendering, with readback of the colour image. class OpenVDBAsset A grid of a VDB file. struct OrArray An attribute declared as T that also takes an array written in place of its value: colours per vertex for one displayColor , a width per point. class OrbitController Interactive orbit control of a CameraParams around a target point in a z-up world, for inspecting terrain. class Overlay A named layer of debug drawing: lines, shapes, markers and labels in world coordinates or posed under prims ( OverlayStyle::anchor ), and text and panels on the image itself ( Text , Rect ), drawn over the images of render products that ask for it ( tokens::kOverlays ), after the sensor filters, so they never reach observations that do not. struct OverlayBatch Many overlay items of one kind from arrays on the host or a GPU ( Overlay::Batch ), such as one per world of a batched simulation, or a physics engine's bodies, contacts and particles: the renderer reads the arrays as they are, without copies to the host, and draws each item from them on the GPU. struct OverlayFont struct OverlayGlyph One character of the font ( OverlayTextFont ). struct OverlayHit What a pick of a rendered image found at a pixel ( RenderDelegate::PickOverlay ): the overlay drawing it, and in it a batch's item ( batch the batch, item its index) or a host item ( batch -1, item its OverlayStyle::id ). struct OverlayItem What every overlay item carries besides its geometry. struct OverlayNumberFormat How a Numbers batch prints each of its values: prefix , the value with decimals digits after the point, then suffix , in the style's colour and size , over its background . struct OverlaySegment A line segment of width pixels, dashed every dash pixels ( OverlayStyle::dash ) unless 0. struct OverlaySprite A rectangle facing the image at a fixed size in pixels, placed by a world point: rect spans (x0, y0) to (x1, y1) pixels from where anchor projects, y down. struct OverlayStyle How overlay items look. struct OverlayTriangle A filled triangle. class PagePool The software path of virtual textures, for devices without sparse residency and textures larger than the device's images: resident tiles live in pages, the layers of one 2D array image, which shaders find through a page table ( VirtualTexture ) and filter themselves (bilinear within a page, trilinear across two mips). struct ParticleOptics Mean optical properties per particle of a particle population at one wavelength: scattering and absorption cross sections (m^2) and the phase function at the requested cosines. class Path Absolute path naming a prim in a Scene , as in USD: / is the root and /World/Sun is the child Sun of /World . struct Pds3Label A PDS3 label's keywords, by name; a keyword inside an OBJECT prefixed with the object's name and a dot ( IMAGE.LINES ). class PdsImage A PDS3 image read in place from its mapped file: NASA's Planetary Data System's elevation models and mosaics (LOLA's and MOLA's gridded heights among them), their label attached at the file's start or in a .lbl file beside it. class PipelineLayout A pipeline layout with one push-descriptor set (set 0), the device's bindless heap (set 1, BindlessHeap ) and an optional push-constant block shared by all stages. class Plane A one-sided rectangle facing along its axis. struct PlanetHeightsOptions How a latitude-longitude raster's samples become heights over a planet ( PlanetHeightsOf ). struct PlanetSphere The planet an Atmosphere wraps, in world space. struct PlanetTile A square of a planet's cube-face grid read from a latitude- longitude raster ( PlanetTileOf ), its points row by row. class PointBased Geometry from an array of points: a mesh or a point cloud. class PointInstancer Instances of its prototypes (the prototypes relationship's targets) at rows of positions, orientations and scales. class Points Points drawn as spheres widths across, coloured by their display colour. struct PolarStereographicDem A planet's radius on a polar stereographic grid (spherical, true at the pole), as LOLA's polar LDEM products hold it: heights (metres above referenceRadius ) row by row, mapScale metres a pixel at the pole. struct Polarizer A camera's linear polarizer ( tokens::kPolarizerType ): none, one in front of the lens at angle (radians from the image's +x towards +y), or a polarization sensor's mosaic of 2 x 2 pixels at 90, 45 / 135, 0 degrees (Sony's IMX250MZR). class Prim Handle to a prim in a Scene : its path plus the scene, for chained edits. class PrimSet A fixed list of prims to write rows of one tensor to at once ( Scene::Write ), such as a simulation's bodies every step: the scene looks the prims up the first time and keeps them, looking them up again only after prims are removed or for another scene. struct PrimTypeDef A registered prim type: its name ( Scene::Define 's type), its base, and the attributes it declares itself; abstract ones, such as "Light", are bases only. struct ProductFrame A rendered frame of a render product: its render targets and how to reach them. struct PushbroomStrip A pushbroom camera's strip for one frame ( CameraParams::pushbroom ), as its shaders project with it (projection_pushbroom.slang): its rows' poses run from from (the top row's camera position) to to (the bottom row's), turning from fromRotation to toRotation along the great arc. class RasterBake A colour or data raster baked into a DDS file a band of rows at a time, as BakeTexture would bake it whole: for images larger than memory, than JPEG's 65535 limit or than one file (a MosaicRaster ), and to spread a bake over a viewer's frames. struct RasterRect A rectangle of a raster's pixels. class RasterSource A raster image read a rectangle at a time, whatever its file: so that planetary mosaics, elevation models and gigapixel photographs larger than memory are baked, resampled and streamed in parts. struct RasterView Non-owning view of a north-up grid of float samples with square cells: the form in which Ernie takes heightfields and albedo maps. class RectLight A rectangle in its xy plane emitting along -z. struct RefinementStencils Each point of a tessellation as a weighted sum of the control points (the limit surface is linear in them), so control points that move, as skinning moves them, refine again by these sums alone: point p is the sum over k in [starts[p], starts[p + 1]) of weights[k] times control point indices[k]. class RefractiveIndex A complex refractive index tabulated at increasing wavelengths (nm), linearly interpolated and constant beyond its ends. struct RegolithProperties A regolith's thermophysical properties and its body's sunlight, the Moon's by default: density rising from its surface value to its deep one over an e-folding depth, contact conductivity following the density, radiative conductivity growing with the cube of temperature, and heat capacity a quartic in temperature. class RenderDelegate A render backend for a Scene , after Hydra's HdRenderDelegate: the rasterizer, and in future ray and path tracers, behind one interface that applications, the GUI viewer and the Python bindings drive without knowing which backend renders. struct TimeWindow The span of the clock the next frame covers, from the last frame's end to now, which the frame after starts from. struct RenderPrims The prims a render of scene uses, as every render delegate resolves them: class RenderProduct One image a render writes: its camera (or a batch of cameras), resolution, render vars and sensor filter chain. struct RenderProductOutput The outputs of one render product in a step: its render vars by name, and the span of the sensor clock its frame covers, seconds ( RenderDelegate::Time ), as ovrtx's frame start and end times. struct RenderProductSpec A render product to draw, resolved from UsdRender prims. class RenderSettings A render's settings: its camera, resolution and products, and the rasterizer's options. class RenderSettingsBase What render settings and products share (UsdRender's RenderSettingsBase ): the camera, the resolution, and what a product sets in place of its settings' (overlays, minimal shading). struct RenderStats What a delegate holds, for statistics panels. class RenderVar An output of a render product, named by its source, optionally with its own sensor chain. class RenderVarOutput One render var of one rendered frame, such as LdrColor , named after UsdRender's RenderVar . class Renderer Ernie's front door for rendering a Scene headless: a GPU and a render backend on it, with no graphics API to set up. struct RendererInfo What a render backend is and does, so applications, settings panels and bindings can adapt. struct RendererOptions Options for creating a Renderer . struct RenderingTarget Attachments of one dynamic-rendering pass. struct SampleBracket Where time falls among samples at times (increasing, not empty): the samples either side and how far between them, 0 at the lower; one sample (both the same, 0) at or outside the ends and on a sample. class Sampler An owned VkSampler . struct SamplerDesc Sampler filtering and addressing. class Scene A lightweight, USD-shaped scene for Ernie: a tree of typed prims named by Path , each holding attributes by USD name, plus change tracking for render delegates. class SchemaView Base of the typed views: a handle to one prim of a registered type, read-only when made from a const scene. class Scope A grouping without a transform of its own. class ScopedGpuZone An ERNIE_GPU_ZONE for Ernie's profiler: timestamps around the rest of the scope's commands. struct ScreenPlacement Where a screen item ( Overlay::Text , Overlay::Rect ) sits on the image, whatever its size: the point at (fractions of the image's width and height from its top left corner) moved offset pixels (y down), with the item's own point align (fractions of its width and height from its top left) there. class Selection The prims of a type that hold some attributes ( Scene::Select ), as a Fabric query finds the buckets of a type and attributes: found again only once prims of the type come, go, or author or clear an attribute, and kept in one PrimSet meanwhile, so the columns of its attributes stay theirs from step to step. struct SensorChannel One channel of a sensor: its quantum efficiency (electrons per photon) over wavelength. struct SensorFilterModel A sensor filter written in Slang, run in the fused sensor kernel like the built-in ones: a struct typeName in module slang implementing IBandFilter (kind Band , domain Spectrum ), IPixelFilter (kind Pixel , on one of the other domains), or for kind Spatial , which reads the pixels around its own, ISpatialBandFilter (domain Spectrum ) or ISpatialPixelFilter (the other domains). struct SensorFilterOutput One output of a sensor filter. struct SensorFilterParam A custom filter's parameter: a float its prim sets as inputs:<name> , or with size above 1 an array of floats ( float name[size] in the filter's Params , such as a curve; sensor.slang's curveAt reads one), which the prim sets as a float array of any length, resampled linearly to size (a single number fills it). class SensorFilterPrim A SensorFilter prim (Ernie), one step of a sensor filter chain: a filter type and its inputs:* parameters. class SensorFilterRegistry Custom sensor filters a renderer can run, by SensorFilterModel::id . struct SensorFilterStep One filter of a product's chain: a SensorFilter prim's ernie:filter:type , a built-in's name or a registered filter's id, with the floats of its inputs:* attributes by name (without "inputs:"). struct SensorModel An image sensor: channels with quantum efficiency curves, full well, noise, gain and ADC. class Shader A node of a material's network, of the type info:id names, its inputs constants or connections ( <input>.connect ) to other shaders' outputs. class ShaderCompiler Compiles Slang modules at run time. struct ShaderModuleSource One Slang module given as source text. struct ShadowSettings Cascaded shadow map options. struct SigmoidSpectrum A smooth reflectance spectrum in Jakob and Hanika's sigmoid-polynomial form: s(lambda) = 1/2 + x / (2 sqrt(1 + x^2)) with x = c0 t^2 + c1 t + c2 and t the wavelength mapped from 360-830 nm to 0-1. class SkelAnimation Joint transforms and blend shape weights sampled over time. class SkelRoot The root of a skinned character: the meshes and skeletons under it go together. class Skeleton Joints in a hierarchy, with the transforms their meshes were bound at and their rest pose, posed by an animation source. struct SkeletonPose A Skeleton posed at a time. struct SkinBinding What binds a Mesh to its Skeleton . struct Shape Each blend shape by the name animations weight it: its first sub-shape (its primary; its inbetweens follow) and the inbetweens' weights. struct SubShape A blend shape's primary shape or one of its inbetweens. struct SkinPose A skinned mesh's pose at a time. class SparseImage A 2D image whose memory is bound tile by tile (Vulkan sparse residency), the hardware path of virtual textures: a texture far larger than device memory holds only the tiles in view, and filtering spans tiles in hardware. struct SparseImageDesc Description of a SparseImage : one 2D layer, sampled. struct SparseTile A tile of a virtual texture: mip mip 's tile at ( x , y ), counted in tiles from the top left. struct SpectralBands A wavelength range split into count bands of equal width, the spectral sampling of one camera. class Spectrum A spectrum tabulated at increasing wavelengths and linearly interpolated between them; constant beyond the first and last samples. class Sphere A sphere centred on its origin. class SphereLight A sphere (or point) light, optionally shaped to a cone around its -z axis. class Stage A scene's stage metadata, as UsdStage keeps it on its pseudo-root: its units (the up axis, metres and kilograms per unit), its time (time codes and frames per second, the range animation plays over, and the time code it is at) and its default prim. struct Star One star of a StarField , as renders take it: where it is and the black-body spectrum it shines with. struct StarCatalogue A star catalogue as a StarField 's arrays take it: right ascension and declination in degrees, visual magnitude and B-V colour index per star. class StarField Stars from a catalogue as points of light at infinity, behind everything else, each with a black-body spectrum. struct StarFieldParams The stars of a StarField prim ( StarsOf ) are uploaded when they change; each frame takes only where the catalogue's frame lies ( StarFieldParamsOf ). class StepOperation A submitted step: poll or wait for its GPU work, then fetch its outputs. struct SubdivisionSurface A subdivision surface's control mesh and tags, as USD's Mesh holds them. class Swapchain A presentation swapchain for a window surface, with one "rendered" semaphore per image. struct Frame One acquired image, ready to render into after waiting on acquired ; signal rendered when done and pass the frame to Present . class Targets Relationship targets given to a setter: one target (a Path or its text), stored as a single Path , or a list of them, stored as a list; reads take either. struct TemperatureModel A surface's temperature computed as it renders, written in Slang: what a thermal camera sees of a body whose temperatures follow its lighting, with no solver running beside the renderer (PANGU's approach). struct TemperatureModelParam One parameter of a temperature model, which a material gives in ernie:thermal:model:params in this order. class TemperatureModelRegistry Temperature models a renderer can run, by TemperatureModel::id . class Tensor A strided n-dimensional view of typed memory with an optional owner that keeps it alive: Ernie's end of DLPack. class Terrain A north-up heightfield (x east, y north, z up) drawn with its bound material, or, with a planet radius, a whole planet of six cube faces ( CubeSphereLod ). class TextureCache Textures prepared at load kept between runs as DDS files (as RasterDelegate keeps image files' textures encoded to BC7 on the GPU), so that a texture decodes, mips and encodes once until its file, or how it is read, changes. struct TextureData A texture as a DDS or KTX2 file stores it, not decoded: each layer's mips of format , mip 0 full size and each next halved (at least 1), with a cube map's six faces as layers. struct TextureFormatInfo What a TextureFormat stores. struct TextureReader A texture read through mesh texture coordinates: a UsdUVTexture with the primvar reader and UsdTransform2d feeding it, which is also glTF's textureInfo with KHR_texture_transform and MaterialX's image, texcoord and place2d nodes. struct TextureWait What RenderDelegate::WaitForTextures left: textures still loading when it timed out, and the errors of those that failed. struct ThermalSettings Thermal emission ( RenderSettings ' ernie:thermal:* ): whether materials glow at their temperatures, the temperature of those without their own (0, none), and the background's, which the frame's dome carries ( FrameParamsOf adds it to the dome's radiance). class TiffImage A TIFF or GeoTIFF image read in place from its mapped file: its layout, and rectangles of its samples decoded on demand, so that images larger than memory (planetary mosaics and elevation models, gigapixel photographs) read a part at a time ( RasterSource ). class TileStore Where a virtual texture's resident tiles live on the device: a sparse image's bound tiles ( SparseImage , filtered in hardware) or a pool of pages ( PagePool , paged in software). struct TimeSample One time sample of an attribute: a value, or a tensor and the CUDA stream it was written on ( Scene::Write ). struct TimelinePoint A wait for or a signal of a timeline semaphore value in a submission. struct TriangleCorners Where each corner of TriangulateFaces ' triangles comes from: its face and its position in faceVertexIndices , for primvars with uniform and faceVarying interpolation. struct UsdImportOptions struct UsdImportResult struct UsdVariantSelection A variant selection made before a USD stage is translated: the variant set set of the USD prim prim set to selection . class Value A scene attribute value: one of the scalar, vector, matrix, token, relationship and small-array types Ernie's schemas use. class Volume A participating medium: fields, each named by a relationship field:<name> to a field prim, shaded by the bound Material 's volume inputs (density, albedo, emission, temperature). struct VolumeFieldParams struct VolumeMaterialParams How a volume's fields shade: its Material 's volume inputs ( material_schemas.h ), the emission colour times its strength. struct VolumeParams A Volume ( VolumesOf ): where it is, which world, its material and its density, temperature and emission fields, each optional. struct VolumeSettings How finely volumes render ( RenderSettings ' ernie:volumes:* ): steps through each volume, towards each light, up and down for the sky's light (0, unoccluded) and through the air in front (0, none), the most orders of multiple scattering, and the texels across the volumes' shadow maps. class VulkanContext Owns a Vulkan instance, device, graphics and compute queue, and memory allocator. struct ExportedBuffer A Shared buffer's handles, which whichever goes first of the buffer and this context destroys (under mutex ), nulling them: an array a scene still holds over the buffer after its renderer is gone keeps the memory through CUDA's import of it. struct VulkanContextOptions Options for VulkanContext::Create . class WorkerPool A few threads running jobs in the order they come, such as textures decoded while frames render. class Xform A transform grouping its children. struct XformOps A prim's local transform as translate, rotate (Euler angles or a quaternion) and scale, the ops of USD's UsdGeomXformCommonAPI. class XformPart A part of XformOps , set or not, read as std::optional<T> is ( if (part) , *part ). class XformRotation The rotation part of XformOps as a quaternion: a glm::dquat , or its real part then its imaginary one, as OpenUSD's GfQuatd(real, imaginary) ( {1, {0, 0, 0}} turns nothing), never four numbers alone (w may be first or last). class XformVector A vector part of XformOps : a glm::dvec3 , three numbers ( {1, 2, 3} ), or any contiguous range of three ( std::array , std::vector , std::span ), so that no glm type is needed. namespace app Editing a camera's sensor chain (the Camera panel's Filter Chain): a RenderProduct 's ernie:filters and its SensorFilter prims, as ordinary scene edits. struct CaptureNameFields What a capture's file name may name ( ExpandCaptureName ). struct CaptureOptions Where the viewer's captures go ( Viewer::GetCaptureOptions ). struct CreatableType A prim type the viewer's Create menu makes, with its menu label and group, the name new prims take, and the prim they go under unless a group prim is selected. struct CreateContext Where a new prim goes and what it starts from. class Demo A demo: a scene built in the constructor, advanced by Step , drawn by Render and checked by TestFinal , run by DemoRunner in a window, headless or without a viewer. struct DemoInfo A demo the runner can build, for the Demos panel and DemoMain . struct DemoOptions The options every demo takes ( ParseDemoOptions ), as Newton's examples share theirs. struct DemoRegistration Registers a demo at static initialization, for RegisteredDemos . class DemoRunner Runs demos as Newton's examples run: opens the viewer the options ask for (or none), runs a demo until its window closes or it has run its frames, then writes --output , runs its final test and reports the benchmark. struct DirectoryEntry One row of a folder listing. struct DockSizes The default layout's docks as fractions of the window: what each takes of the space left once the docks before it are placed (left, then the right column, then the bottom). class FileDialog A modal file browser drawn with Dear ImGui, which Viewer shows for OpenFileDialog : a folder's contents with an Up button, an editable path and shortcuts to home, the working directory, the root and the folders used recently, a name field, a file type menu and Open (or Save) and Cancel. struct FileDialogOptions What a file dialog asks for ( Viewer::OpenFileDialog ). struct FileFilter A choice of the file dialog's file type menu: a label and the extensions it shows, such as {"Terrain configurations", {".json"}}; no extensions shows every file. struct FrameInfo Per-frame information passed to OnFrame , OnPreRender and OnPostRender callbacks. class FunctionPanel A panel that draws its contents by calling a function. struct LogEntry One message of the viewer's log ( Viewer::Log ). class Panel A dockable window of the viewer. struct PropertyField One known attribute a panel edits: how to show it, and what Ernie uses when it is not authored. struct PropertySection A titled group of fields, such as a prim type's "Light" or "Shape" attributes. struct SequenceOptions A sequence to record ( Viewer::RecordSequence ). struct Theme Colours (sRGB-encoded with alpha, as written to the screen) and metrics of the viewer's UI: a classic scientific desktop look, as Qt's and GTK's of the 2000s that tools such as PANGU wear (colours read from PANGU v7's renderer GUI): light grey-green windows (#D4D7D0), white sunken fields and raised buttons with one-pixel edges, square corners, black text, a navy accent and pale-blue selection. class Timeline The animation's clock, as Omniverse Kit's timeline: plays the scene's time code ( Stage::GetTimeCode ) over the stage's range, from its start time code to its end, in real time or a frame at a time, looping or stopping at the end. class Viewer An interactive window onto an Ernie Scene : a docked viewport rendering the scene with a RenderDelegate (the rasterizer), plus Stage , Property, Render Settings, Sensor, Stats and Log panels. class ViewerLogs What the viewer's logging calls collect ( Viewer::LogScalar , LogArray , LogImage ), after Newton's viewers' log_scalar , log_array and log_image : scalar signals and arrays drawn in the Plots panel, and images each in a panel of its own, as textures the GPU samples where they were written. struct ViewerOptions Options for opening a Viewer . struct ViewportDisplay What the viewport draws over the scene, as Kit's viewport "show by type" menu (the eye) and heads-up display settings choose. class WidgetPanel A panel of simple widgets described by data rather than ImGui calls, so code without ImGui bindings (Python) can build one. namespace icons Lucide icon glyphs (lucide-static 1.52.0, private-use codepoints) as UTF-8 strings, for text drawn with the viewer's font, which has the icons merged in: ImGui::Button(icons::kSave) , or std::string(icons::kCamera) + " Camera" as a label. namespace menu namespace detail What the view macros expand to. namespace log What Ernie prints about itself on standard output, as Warp does ( wp.config.quiet , wp.config.verbose ): a banner once it starts on a GPU, with its version, device and cache folders, and a line for each shader it compiles, more with verbosity (shaders and textures its caches answer) and nothing when quiet. namespace memory The device memory Ernie's buffers and images hold, for the viewer's Profiler panel: each live GpuBuffer and GpuImage registers its allocation under a category from its usage (render targets, textures, storage buffers, ...) until it is released. struct Allocation One live allocation. namespace profiler Summaries of the profiler's frames ( ernie/util/profiler.h ) as Omniverse Kit's profiler window shows them: each zone nested in the zone that encloses it, with its time averaged over the frames, its share of the frame, and exports as text, JSON and a Chrome trace. struct Frame One frame's zones. struct Report The GPU's zones and the CPU's, the latter under a node per thread. struct ReportFilter What to list of a report: zones nested at most depth deep (0: the outermost alone) and taking at least minMs , in a tree whose siblings come in the order they ran or, byTime , longest first. struct ReportNode A zone's averages over the frames summarized: zones of the same name under the same parent merge. struct ReportRow A listed zone and how deep it is shown. class ScopedZone Times the rest of the enclosing scope as a CPU zone named name while recording. struct Zone A timed span: a CPU zone of thread thread , or a GPU zone ( thread unused) on the device's own clock. namespace reflectance_table struct Entry namespace render_vars Render var names, after Omniverse's where it has the quantity. namespace solar_table namespace tokens Prim type and attribute names, following UsdGeom, UsdLux, UsdShade and UsdRender where those schemas have the concept, with Ernie's own under ernie: . struct Array struct Held What a slot holds: an image view and its layout, or a sampler. struct HeldHash struct SharedSlot struct PrimSnapshot One prim of a removed subtree, enough to define it again. struct Step struct Copy struct Staging struct Pending struct Retiring A finished zone's queries, reset once kRetireCollects more collects have passed. struct ColumnData Rows of one tensor that many prims' attribute is ( Write of a PrimSet ), written again or unmapped whole in one step. struct PrimData struct Bound Attributes that are rows of a column ( columns_ ): which, its row, and the column's version its tensors last took ( Refresh ), so a column written whole costs its prims nothing until read. struct StorageLink SetColumnStorage 's, which copies of the scene do not take. struct UniqueId A process-wide unique id that copies and assignments renew. struct Array struct Scalar struct ValueTypeOf The type an attribute declared as T holds as a value. struct ValueTypeOf< OrArray< T > > namespace std struct hash< ernie::Path >
docs.title: Classes

docs.text: Here are the classes, structs, unions and interfaces with brief descriptions: namespace ernie Planetary digital elevation models, as the PDS archives them, and the local heightfields Ernie's Terrain draws of them. struct AnimationPose A SkelAnimation 's samples interpolated at a time: empty arrays for those it lacks. class Atmosphere A planet's atmosphere from a physical model ( EarthAtmosphere , MarsAtmosphere ): its gases and aerosols scatter and absorb the sun's light on its way to the ground, the sun's DistantLight then giving the irradiance above the atmosphere. struct AtmosphereModel A spherical shell of constituents around a planet of radius bottomRadius , up to bottomRadius + topAltitude . struct AtmosphereParams A planet's atmosphere ( AtmosphereParamsOf ): the physical model's settings and where the planet lies. class AttributeDef One declared attribute of a prim type. struct AttributeMeta How an attribute is described and edited. struct AttributeTraits How the declared C++ type T reads, writes and converts: Read with the fallback (accepting any numeric or vector type an author used, as GetNumber does), Write , and From , a value as T or nullopt when it cannot be one. struct AttributeTraits< OrArray< T > > struct AttributeTraits< Path > struct AttributeTraits< Tensor > Bulk data: reads the written tensor or null (there is no fallback), writes with Scene::Write . struct AttributeTraits< bool > struct AttributeTraits< double > struct AttributeTraits< glm::dmat4 > struct AttributeTraits< glm::dquat > struct AttributeTraits< glm::dvec2 > struct AttributeTraits< glm::dvec3 > struct AttributeTraits< glm::dvec4 > struct AttributeTraits< int > struct AttributeTraits< std::string > struct AttributeTraits< std::vector< Path > > struct AttributeTraits< std::vector< float > > struct AttributeTraits< std::vector< std::string > > class AxisShape An implicit shape centred on its origin along one of its axes: a cylinder, cone, capsule or plane. struct BakeOptions How BakeTexture stores a texture. struct BandedAtmosphere An atmosphere averaged over a camera's spectral bands, ready for rendering. struct Refraction A refracted ray traced from radius r (m) at the apparent zenith cosine mu out of the atmosphere, through its spherically layered refractive index ( RefractiveIndex ), by the ray equation d(n t)/ds = grad n with steps of at most step m. struct BandedConstituent A constituent averaged over a camera's spectral bands. class BindlessHeap Every pass's textures and samplers in one descriptor set (set 1 of every PipelineLayout ), each at an index shaders take from their uniforms: bindless descriptor indexing, so a pass's long-lived textures cost it no binding of its own (bindless.slang declares the arrays). class Slot A slot of the heap, freed when destroyed; move-only. class BlendShape Offsets of a mesh's points (and normals), weighted by an animation, with inbetween shapes at weights between 0 and 1. class BlockEncoder Encodes RGBA8 images into BC blocks away from the CPU, as GpuBlockEncoder does on the GPU: bakes use it for the formats it encodes, the CPU's encoders for the rest. class Boundable What has local bounds: geometry and instancers, with an optional authored extent. class BoundableLight An area light (sphere, rect, disk): a radiant power, or a photometric power or illuminance. struct BrdfModel A reflectance model: shader source plus parameter metadata. struct BrdfParam One scalar parameter of a reflectance model, with what a UI needs to edit it. class BrdfRegistry Reflectance models available to a renderer, keyed by BrdfModel::id . class CacheKey A cache's 128-bit key for everything an entry depends on: two 64-bit FNV-1a hashes from different starts, each piece length-prefixed. struct CahvoreModel A camera calibrated in JPL's CAHV family of models, as Mars rovers' cameras are (their PDS labels' GEOMETRIC_CAMERA_MODEL, JPL's camera model files): CAHV, a linear (pinhole) model; CAHVOR, with radial distortion about an optical axis; and CAHVORE, with a fish-eye term and an entrance pupil that moves along the optical axis with the field angle, so its rays do not meet at one point. struct ErnieCamera The model as Ernie renders it, in the model's frame (camera to frame). struct Ray A projection ray: its origin (C, or for CAHVORE the entrance pupil's position for its field angle) and unit direction. class Camera A camera looking down its -z axis with +y up: UsdGeomCamera's projection, apertures, clipping, exposure and shutter, and Ernie's lens, scan, spectral sampling, sensor and view poses. struct CameraParams A camera's parameters resolved from its Camera prim ( CameraParamsOf ): a physically based pinhole camera for one image, with UsdGeomCamera's pose, projection and exposure attributes, a spectral range, a lens and a sensor. struct CameraView The raster view of a camera for one frame, derived from a CameraParams by CameraParams::RasterView : what the rasterizer's passes need. class Capsule A cylinder with hemispherical caps along its axis. struct Change A prim's changes since a consumer last looked. struct ChangeCursor A consumer's position in a scene's history; see Scene::Changes . class ChunkedFrameImages The images of a frame of a batch of views that do not fit one set of images (such as more views than an image has layers): consecutive chunks of the views, each its own FrameImages . class CloudLayersField Ernie's procedural cloud layers: up to four layers over a repeating weather map, carved from tileable noise at each sample on the GPU (three-geospatial's clouds, after Horizon Zero Dawn's), in the field's frame with z up; a Volume 's density, its material's density scaling it. struct CloudLayersParams A field a volume shades with ( VolumesOf ): a grid of a NanoVDB file, an OpenVDBAsset 's, or of a NanoVDBField 's array ( buffer ). struct CloudNoise The tileable noise textures procedural cloud layers are carved from (volume.slang's cloudLayersDensity ): a Perlin-Worley shape and a Worley detail, each repeating in all three axes, a local weather map of the layers' coverage and a curl-noise turbulence, both repeating across. struct CloudTransportOptions struct CloudTransportShape The canonical transport table's lattice. struct CloudTransportTable Light transport in a plane-parallel slab of cloud lit from above by a distant source, for each set of scattering orders (2 and more): the radiance at a view point inside it in each direction of travel, and where on the lit face that light entered, its collector. struct ColorPrimvar The colours a material's diffuse colour reads through a UsdPrimvarReader_float or _float3: the mesh primvar ( primvars:<name> ), one value or three each ( width ), and the reader's fallback where a mesh has none. class Column One attribute of many prims as rows of one array, as a simulation keeps its bodies' poses: written whole from any array (CPU or CUDA, DLPack, no copy), or mapped and written in place on the device asked for, each write one change ( ColumnChange ) whatever the number of prims. struct ColumnChange One attribute of many prims written whole as rows of one tensor ( Scene::Write of a PrimSet again, or Scene::Unmap of it) since a cursor, as Scene::Changes reports it to a consumer that takes the rows whole. class ColumnStorage Storage a consumer of columns offers for them on a device it reads them on, such as a renderer's interop buffers: a column mapped there ( Column::Map ) is then written where the consumer reads it, copying nothing. struct Rows Rows a consumer offers, and whether they are storage it keeps (mapped again, the same rows) rather than a copy made there for now. struct ComputeArrayView A Vulkan image seen by a compute API in place, as an opaque array handle (a CUarray for CUDA, a hipArray_t for HIP): read it with that API's texture or surface objects or 2D array copies. class ComputeInterop Zero-copy sharing between a Vulkan device and the compute device behind it (CUDA or HIP), so arrays from compute frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, CuPy, Warp, simulators) reach Ernie's buffers, and Ernie's results reach them, without passing through host memory. class ComputePipeline A compute pipeline over a PipelineLayout . class Cone A capped cone along its axis, its apex at +height / 2. struct Connection The source of a UsdShade connection: a Shader prim and one of its outputs, e.g. struct Constituent One constituent of an atmosphere: numberDensity particles per m^3 where its profile is 1. class Cube A box centred on its origin, size along each axis. class CubeSphereLod CDLOD terrain over a whole planet: six LodQuadtree height pyramids, one per face of a cube projected onto a sphere of radius Radius() (a quadrilateralized or "cubed" sphere). struct CubeSphereRegion Region of space holding one node of a CubeSphereLod : every direction within angle of axis , between radii inner and outer from the body's centre. class CudaInterop ComputeInterop for the CUDA device behind a Vulkan device. class Cylinder A capped cylinder along its axis. class CylinderLight A cylinder along its x axis emitting from its side as a Lambertian emitter, not its caps. struct CylindricalDem A planet's radius on an equirectangular grid, as LOLA's LDEM products (simple cylindrical, true at the equator) and LROC's NAC DTMs (true at a standard parallel) hold it: heights (metres above referenceRadius ; NaN where the product has no data) row by row from the northern, each row from the western sample eastwards, pixelsPerDegree along the meridians and that times cos(standardParallel) along the parallels. class DenseField Ernie's field of a dense array of values, MaterialX's image, texcoord and place2d nodes. struct TextureWait What RenderDelegate::WaitForTextures left: textures still loading when it timed out, and the errors of those that failed. struct ThermalSettings Thermal emission ( RenderSettings ' ernie:thermal:* ): whether materials glow at their temperatures, the temperature of those without their own (0, none), and the background's, which the frame's dome carries ( FrameParamsOf adds it to the dome's radiance). class TiffImage A TIFF or GeoTIFF image read in place from its mapped file: its layout, and rectangles of its samples decoded on demand, so that images larger than memory (planetary mosaics and elevation models, gigapixel photographs) read a part at a time ( RasterSource ). class TileStore Where a virtual texture's resident tiles live on the device: a sparse image's bound tiles ( SparseImage , filtered in hardware) or a pool of pages ( PagePool , paged in software). struct TimeSample One time sample of an attribute: a value, or a tensor and the CUDA stream it was written on ( Scene::Write ). struct TimelinePoint A wait for or a signal of a timeline semaphore value in a submission. struct TriangleCorners Where each corner of TriangulateFaces ' triangles comes from: its face and its position in faceVertexIndices , for primvars with uniform and faceVarying interpolation. struct UsdImportOptions struct UsdImportResult struct UsdVariantSelection A variant selection made before a USD stage is translated: the variant set set of the USD prim prim set to selection . class Value A scene attribute value: one of the scalar, vector, matrix, token, relationship and small-array types Ernie's schemas use. class Volume A participating medium: fields, each named by a relationship field:<name> to a field prim, shaded by the bound Material 's volume inputs (density, albedo, emission, temperature). struct VolumeFieldParams struct VolumeMaterialParams How a volume's fields shade: its Material 's volume inputs ( material_schemas.h ), the emission colour times its strength. struct VolumeParams A Volume ( VolumesOf ): where it is, which world, its material and its density, temperature and emission fields, each optional. struct VolumeSettings How finely volumes render ( RenderSettings ' ernie:volumes:* ): steps through each volume, towards each light, up and down for the sky's light (0, unoccluded) and through the air in front (0, none), the most orders of multiple scattering, and the texels across the volumes' shadow maps. class VulkanContext Owns a Vulkan instance, device, graphics and compute queue, and memory allocator. struct ExportedBuffer A Shared buffer's handles, which whichever goes first of the buffer and this context destroys (under mutex ), nulling them: an array a scene still holds over the buffer after its renderer is gone keeps the memory through CUDA's import of it. struct VulkanContextOptions Options for VulkanContext::Create . class WorkerPool A few threads running jobs in the order they come, such as textures decoded while frames render. class Xform A transform grouping its children. struct XformOps A prim's local transform as translate, rotate (Euler angles or a quaternion) and scale, the ops of USD's UsdGeomXformCommonAPI. class XformPart A part of XformOps , set or not, read as std::optional<T> is ( if (part) , *part ). class XformRotation The rotation part of XformOps as a quaternion: a glm::dquat , or its real part then its imaginary one, as OpenUSD's GfQuatd(real, imaginary) ( {1, {0, 0, 0}} turns nothing), never four numbers alone (w may be first or last). class XformVector A vector part of XformOps : a glm::dvec3 , three numbers ( {1, 2, 3} ), or any contiguous range of three ( std::array , std::vector , std::span ), so that no glm type is needed. namespace app Editing a camera's sensor chain (the Camera panel's Filter Chain): a RenderProduct 's ernie:filters and its SensorFilter prims, as ordinary scene edits. struct CaptureNameFields What a capture's file name may name ( ExpandCaptureName ). struct CaptureOptions Where the viewer's captures go ( Viewer::GetCaptureOptions ). struct CreatableType A prim type the viewer's Create menu makes, with its menu label and group, the name new prims take, and the prim they go under unless a group prim is selected. struct CreateContext Where a new prim goes and what it starts from. class Demo A demo: a scene built in the constructor, advanced by Step , drawn by Render and checked by TestFinal , run by DemoRunner in a window, headless or without a viewer. struct DemoInfo A demo the runner can build, for the Demos panel and DemoMain . struct DemoOptions The options every demo takes ( ParseDemoOptions ), as Newton's examples share theirs. struct DemoRegistration Registers a demo at static initialization, for RegisteredDemos . class DemoRunner Runs demos as Newton's examples run: opens the viewer the options ask for (or none), runs a demo until its window closes or it has run its frames, then writes --output , runs its final test and reports the benchmark. struct DirectoryEntry One row of a folder listing. struct DockSizes The default layout's docks as fractions of the window: what each takes of the space left once the docks before it are placed (left, then the right column, then the bottom). class FileDialog A modal file browser drawn with Dear ImGui, which Viewer shows for OpenFileDialog : a folder's contents with an Up button, an editable path and shortcuts to home, the working directory, the root and the folders used recently, a name field, a file type menu and Open (or Save) and Cancel. struct FileDialogOptions What a file dialog asks for ( Viewer::OpenFileDialog ). struct FileFilter A choice of the file dialog's file type menu: a label and the extensions it shows, such as {"Terrain configurations", {".json"}}; no extensions shows every file. struct FrameInfo Per-frame information passed to OnFrame , OnPreRender and OnPostRender callbacks. class FunctionPanel A panel that draws its contents by calling a function. struct LogEntry One message of the viewer's log ( Viewer::Log ). class Panel A dockable window of the viewer. struct PropertyField One known attribute a panel edits: how to show it, and what Ernie uses when it is not authored. struct PropertySection A titled group of fields, such as a prim type's "Light" or "Shape" attributes. struct SequenceOptions A sequence to record ( Viewer::RecordSequence ). struct Theme Colours (sRGB-encoded with alpha, as written to the screen) and metrics of the viewer's UI: a classic scientific desktop look, as Qt's and GTK's of the 2000s that tools such as PANGU wear (colours read from PANGU v7's renderer GUI): light grey-green windows (#D4D7D0), white sunken fields and raised buttons with one-pixel edges, square corners, black text, a navy accent and pale-blue selection. class Timeline The animation's clock, as Omniverse Kit's timeline: plays the scene's time code ( Stage::GetTimeCode ) over the stage's range, from its start time code to its end, in real time or a frame at a time, looping or stopping at the end. class Viewer An interactive window onto an Ernie Scene : a docked viewport rendering the scene with a RenderDelegate (the rasterizer), plus Stage , Property, Render Settings, Sensor, Stats and Log panels. class ViewerLogs What the viewer's logging calls collect ( Viewer::LogScalar , LogArray , LogImage ), after Newton's viewers' log_scalar , log_array and log_image : scalar signals and arrays drawn in the Plots panel, and images each in a panel of its own, as textures the GPU samples where they were written. struct ViewerOptions Options for opening a Viewer . struct ViewportDisplay What the viewport draws over the scene, as Kit's viewport "show by type" menu (the eye) and heads-up display settings choose. class WidgetPanel A panel of simple widgets described by data rather than ImGui calls, so code without ImGui bindings (Python) can build one. namespace icons Lucide icon glyphs (lucide-static 1.52.0, private-use codepoints) as UTF-8 strings, for text drawn with the viewer's font, which has the icons merged in: ImGui::Button(icons::kSave) , or std::string(icons::kCamera) + " Camera" as a label. namespace menu namespace detail What the view macros expand to. namespace log What Ernie prints about itself on standard output, as Warp does ( wp.config.quiet , wp.config.verbose ): a banner once it starts on a GPU, with its version, device and cache folders, and a line for each shader it compiles, more with verbosity (shaders and textures its caches answer) and nothing when quiet. namespace memory The device memory Ernie's buffers and images hold, for the viewer's Profiler panel: each live GpuBuffer and GpuImage registers its allocation under a category from its usage (render targets, textures, storage buffers, ...) until it is released. struct Allocation One live allocation. namespace profiler Summaries of the profiler's frames ( ernie/util/profiler.h ) as Omniverse Kit's profiler window shows them: each zone nested in the zone that encloses it, with its time averaged over the frames, its share of the frame, and exports as text, JSON and a Chrome trace. struct Frame One frame's zones. struct Report The GPU's zones and the CPU's, the latter under a node per thread. struct ReportFilter What to list of a report: zones nested at most depth deep (0: the outermost alone) and taking at least minMs , in a tree whose siblings come in the order they ran or, byTime , longest first. struct ReportNode A zone's averages over the frames summarized: zones of the same name under the same parent merge. struct ReportRow A listed zone and how deep it is shown. class ScopedZone Times the rest of the enclosing scope as a CPU zone named name while recording. struct Zone A timed span: a CPU zone of thread thread , or a GPU zone ( thread unused) on the device's own clock. namespace reflectance_table struct Entry namespace render_vars Render var names, after Omniverse's where it has the quantity. namespace solar_table namespace tokens Prim type and attribute names, following UsdGeom, UsdLux, UsdShade and UsdRender where those schemas have the concept, with Ernie's own under ernie: . struct Array struct Held What a slot holds: an image view and its layout, or a sampler. struct HeldHash struct SharedSlot struct PrimSnapshot One prim of a removed subtree, enough to define it again. struct Step struct Copy struct Staging struct Pending struct Retiring A finished zone's queries, reset once kRetireCollects more collects have passed. struct ColumnData Rows of one tensor that many prims' attribute is ( Write of a PrimSet ), written again or unmapped whole in one step. struct PrimData struct Bound Attributes that are rows of a column ( columns_ ): which, its row, and the column's version its tensors last took ( Refresh ), so a column written whole costs its prims nothing until read. struct StorageLink SetColumnStorage 's, which copies of the scene do not take. struct UniqueId A process-wide unique id that copies and assignments renew. struct Array struct Scalar struct ValueTypeOf The type an attribute declared as T holds as a value. struct ValueTypeOf< OrArray< T > > namespace std struct hash< ernie::Path >
