Classes Type Name struct AtmosphereParams A planet's atmosphere ( AtmosphereParamsOf ): the physical model's settings and where the planet lies. struct CloudLayersParams A field a volume shades with ( VolumesOf ): a grid of a NanoVDB file, an OpenVDBAsset 's, or of a NanoVDBField 's array ( buffer ). struct DomeParams An environment light at infinity (UsdLux DomeLight ) resolved for a frame ( DomeParamsOf ): radiance from every direction, the spectrum radiance (W m^-2 sr^-1 nm^-1 per camera band) times a relative RGB map whose cosine-convolved spherical harmonics are sh . struct FrameParams Per-frame parameters of a render, whatever the backend: the camera, the lights, the sensor filters and the frame's place in the random streams. struct SensorChain Several sensor chains over the one raster image, each writing its own vars (render vars with their own ernie:filters ); empty runs filters for vars . struct LightParams A light, resolved for a frame from its prim ( LightParamsOf ). struct Beam A laser's Gaussian beam (Siegman 1986): its 1/e^2 radius at the waist along the light's x and y, its Rayleigh range along each, and the waist's distance along the beam from position , m. struct Lit One frame of its sequence lit during a span of time, and how much: the light's mean over the span relative to its average power. struct Pose Where a light is: its position , direction and tangent . struct PushbroomStrip A pushbroom camera's strip for one frame ( CameraParams::pushbroom ), as its shaders project with it (projection_pushbroom.slang): its rows' poses run from from (the top row's camera position) to to (the bottom row's), turning from fromRotation to toRotation along the great arc. struct ShadowSettings Cascaded shadow map options. struct Star One star of a StarField , as renders take it: where it is and the black-body spectrum it shines with. struct StarFieldParams The stars of a StarField prim ( StarsOf ) are uploaded when they change; each frame takes only where the catalogue's frame lies ( StarFieldParamsOf ). struct ThermalSettings Thermal emission ( RenderSettings ' ernie:thermal:* ): whether materials glow at their temperatures, the temperature of those without their own (0, none), and the background's, which the frame's dome carries ( FrameParamsOf adds it to the dome's radiance). struct VolumeFieldParams struct VolumeMaterialParams How a volume's fields shade: its Material 's volume inputs ( material_schemas.h ), the emission colour times its strength. struct VolumeParams A Volume ( VolumesOf ): where it is, which world, its material and its density, temperature and emission fields, each optional. struct VolumeSettings How finely volumes render ( RenderSettings ' ernie:volumes:* ): steps through each volume, towards each light, up and down for the sky's light (0, unoccluded) and through the air in front (0, none), the most orders of multiple scattering, and the texels across the volumes' shadow maps. docs.text: File least_squares.h File List > ernie > util > least_squares.h Go to the documentation of this file // SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-3-Clause #pragma once #include <array> #include <cmath> #include <cstddef> #include <utility> namespace ernie { template <std::size_t N> std::array<double, N> SolveNormal(std::array<std::array<double, N>, N> normal, std::array<double, N> right, std::size_t n) { std::array<double, N> scale{}; for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) { scale[i] = normal[i][i] > 0.0 ? 1.0 / std::sqrt(normal[i][i]) : 0.0; } for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) { for (std::size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) { normal[i][j] *= scale[i] * scale[j]; } right[i] *= scale[i]; } for (std::size_t c = 0; c < n; ++c) { std::size_t pivot = c; for (std::size_t r = c + 1; r < n; ++r) { if (std::abs(normal[r][c]) > std::abs(normal[pivot][c])) { pivot = r; } } if (std::abs(normal[pivot][c]) < 1e-300) { return {}; } std::swap(normal[c], normal[pivot]); std::swap(right[c], right[pivot]); for (std::size_t r = c + 1; r < n; ++r) { const double factor = normal[r][c] / normal[c][c]; for (std::size_t j = c; j < n; ++j) { normal[r][j] -= factor * normal[c][j]; } right[r] -= factor * right[c]; } } std::array<double, N> x{}; for (std::size_t c = n; c-- > 0;) { double sum = right[c]; for (std::size_t j = c + 1; j < n; ++j) { sum -= normal[c][j] * x[j]; } x[c] = sum / normal[c][c]; } for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) { x[i] *= scale[i]; } return x; } template <std::size_t N> struct NormalEquations { std::array<std::array<double, N>, N> normal{}; std::array<double, N> right{}; void Add(const std::array<double, N>& row, double value, std::size_t n = N) { for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) { for (std::size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) { normal[i][j] += row[i] * row[j]; } right[i] += row[i] * value; } } std::array<double, N> Solve(std::size_t n = N) const { return SolveNormal(normal, right, n); } }; } // namespace ernie

docs.text: File List > ernie > util > least_squares.h Go to the documentation of this file // SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-3-Clause #pragma once #include <array> #include <cmath> #include <cstddef> #include <utility> namespace ernie { template <std::size_t N> std::array<double, N> SolveNormal(std::array<std::array<double, N>, N> normal, std::array<double, N> right, std::size_t n) { std::array<double, N> scale{}; for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) { scale[i] = normal[i][i] > 0.0 ? 1.0 / std::sqrt(normal[i][i]) : 0.0; } for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) { for (std::size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) { normal[i][j] *= scale[i] * scale[j]; } right[i] *= scale[i]; } for (std::size_t c = 0; c < n; ++c) { std::size_t pivot = c; for (std::size_t r = c + 1; r < n; ++r) { if (std::abs(normal[r][c]) > std::abs(normal[pivot][c])) { pivot = r; } } if (std::abs(normal[pivot][c]) < 1e-300) { return {}; } std::swap(normal[c], normal[pivot]); std::swap(right[c], right[pivot]); for (std::size_t r = c + 1; r < n; ++r) { const double factor = normal[r][c] / normal[c][c]; for (std::size_t j = c; j < n; ++j) { normal[r][j] -= factor * normal[c][j]; } right[r] -= factor * right[c]; } } std::array<double, N> x{}; for (std::size_t c = n; c-- > 0;) { double sum = right[c]; for (std::size_t j = c + 1; j < n; ++j) { sum -= normal[c][j] * x[j]; } x[c] = sum / normal[c][c]; } for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) { x[i] *= scale[i]; } return x; } template <std::size_t N> struct NormalEquations { std::array<std::array<double, N>, N> normal{}; std::array<double, N> right{}; void Add(const std::array<double, N>& row, double value, std::size_t n = N) { for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) { for (std::size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) { normal[i][j] += row[i] * row[j]; } right[i] += row[i] * value; } } std::array<double, N> Solve(std::size_t n = N) const { return SolveNormal(normal, right, n); } }; } // namespace ernie

docs.text: Namespace List Here is a list of all namespaces with brief descriptions: namespace ernie Planetary digital elevation models, as the PDS archives them, and the local heightfields Ernie's Terrain draws of them. namespace app Editing a camera's sensor chain (the Camera panel's Filter Chain): a RenderProduct 's ernie:filters and its SensorFilter prims, as ordinary scene edits. namespace icons Lucide icon glyphs (lucide-static 1.52.0, private-use codepoints) as UTF-8 strings, for text drawn with the viewer's font, which has the icons merged in: ImGui::Button(icons::kSave) , or std::string(icons::kCamera) + " Camera" as a label. namespace menu namespace detail What the view macros expand to. namespace log What Ernie prints about itself on standard output, as Warp does ( wp.config.quiet , wp.config.verbose ): a banner once it starts on a GPU, with its version, device and cache folders, and a line for each shader it compiles, more with verbosity (shaders and textures its caches answer) and nothing when quiet. namespace memory The device memory Ernie's buffers and images hold, for the viewer's Profiler panel: each live GpuBuffer and GpuImage registers its allocation under a category from its usage (render targets, textures, storage buffers, ...) until it is released. namespace profiler Summaries of the profiler's frames ( ernie/util/profiler.h ) as Omniverse Kit's profiler window shows them: each zone nested in the zone that encloses it, with its time averaged over the frames, its share of the frame, and exports as text, JSON and a Chrome trace. namespace reflectance_table namespace render_vars Render var names, after Omniverse's where it has the quantity. namespace solar_table namespace tokens Prim type and attribute names, following UsdGeom, UsdLux, UsdShade and UsdRender where those schemas have the concept, with Ernie's own under ernie: . namespace std

docs.text: Class Hierarchy This inheritance list is sorted roughly, but not completely, alphabetically: class ernie::SchemaView Base of the typed views: a handle to one prim of a registered type, read-only when made from a const scene. class ernie::Imageable What every prim has: visibility and the world it is in. class ernie::Atmosphere A planet's atmosphere from a physical model ( EarthAtmosphere , MarsAtmosphere ): its gases and aerosols scatter and absorb the sun's light on its way to the ground, the sun's DistantLight then giving the irradiance above the atmosphere. class ernie::BlendShape Offsets of a mesh's points (and normals), weighted by an animation, with inbetween shapes at weights between 0 and 1. class ernie::Boundable What has local bounds: geometry and instancers, with an optional authored extent. class ernie::Gprim Geometry: drawn in a display colour, or with a bound material. class ernie::AxisShape An implicit shape centred on its origin along one of its axes: a cylinder, cone, capsule or plane. class ernie::Capsule A cylinder with hemispherical caps along its axis. class ernie::Cone A capped cone along its axis, its apex at +height / 2. class ernie::Cylinder A capped cylinder along its axis. class ernie::Plane A one-sided rectangle facing along its axis. class ernie::Cube A box centred on its origin, size along each axis. class ernie::PointBased Geometry from an array of points: a mesh or a point cloud. class ernie::Mesh A polygon mesh: points and the faces over them. class ernie::Points Points drawn as spheres widths across, coloured by their display colour. class ernie::Sphere A sphere centred on its origin. class ernie::Terrain A north-up heightfield (x east, y north, z up) drawn with its bound material, or, with a planet radius, a whole planet of six cube faces ( CubeSphereLod ). class ernie::Volume A participating medium: fields, each named by a relationship field:<name> to a field prim, shaded by the bound Material 's volume inputs (density, albedo, emission, temperature). class ernie::PointInstancer Instances of its prototypes (the prototypes relationship's targets) at rows of positions, orientations and scales. class ernie::SkelRoot The root of a skinned character: the meshes and skeletons under it go together. class ernie::Skeleton Joints in a hierarchy, with the transforms their meshes were bound at and their rest pose, posed by an animation source. class ernie::Camera A camera looking down its -z axis with +y up: UsdGeomCamera's projection, apertures, clipping, exposure and shutter, and Ernie's lens, scan, spectral sampling, sensor and view poses. class ernie::FieldBase A field of values over space, which Volumes name; its transform places the field in its Volume (UsdVol's FieldBase ). class ernie::CloudLayersField Ernie's procedural cloud layers: up to four layers over a repeating weather map, carved from tileable noise at each sample on the GPU (three-geospatial's clouds, after Horizon Zero Dawn's), in the field's frame with z up; a Volume 's density, its material's density scaling it. class ernie::DenseField Ernie's field of a dense array of values, such as a grid solver's smoke or dust each step (Warp's arrays): sampled as a NanoVDB grid of every voxel, which a device array fills in place on the GPU. class ernie::FieldAsset A field read from a file (UsdVol's FieldAsset ). class ernie::OpenVDBAsset A grid of a VDB file. class ernie::NanoVDBField Ernie's field of NanoVDB grids written as an array instead of a file, such as a simulation's each step (Warp's Volume.array() ): one of its grids, read as an OpenVDBAsset 's. class ernie::GroundPlane Ernie: an infinite horizontal floor facing +z at a world height, drawn with its material, optionally as a checkerboard. class ernie::LaserLight A laser (Ernie): a Gaussian beam of one spectral line along its -z axis, its waist, divergence and power as a datasheet gives them (ISO 11146). class ernie::Light Any light: UsdLux's LightAPI inputs, its spectrum's shape and Ernie's physical spectrum. class ernie::BoundableLight An area light (sphere, rect, disk): a radiant power, or a photometric power or illuminance. class ernie::CylinderLight A cylinder along its x axis emitting from its side as a Lambertian emitter, not its caps. class ernie::DiskLight A disk in its xy plane emitting along -z. class ernie::RectLight A rectangle in its xy plane emitting along -z. class ernie::SphereLight A sphere (or point) light, optionally shaped to a cone around its -z axis. class ernie::NonboundableLight A light at infinity (distant, dome), whose photometric brightness is an illuminance. class ernie::DistantLight A light at infinity shining along the -z axis of its transform, such as the Sun. class ernie::DomeLight Light from every direction, optionally from a latitude-longitude map. class ernie::Material How a surface reflects light: Ernie's own inputs, or a UsdPreviewSurface its outputs:surface connects to. class ernie::RenderSettingsBase What render settings and products share (UsdRender's RenderSettingsBase ): the camera, the resolution, and what a product sets in place of its settings' (overlays, minimal shading). class ernie::RenderProduct One image a render writes: its camera (or a batch of cameras), resolution, render vars and sensor filter chain. class ernie::RenderSettings A render's settings: its camera, resolution and products, and the rasterizer's options. class ernie::RenderVar An output of a render product, named by its source, optionally with its own sensor chain. class ernie::Scope A grouping without a transform of its own. class ernie::SensorFilterPrim A SensorFilter prim (Ernie), one step of a sensor filter chain: a filter type and its inputs:* parameters. class ernie::Shader A node of a material's network, of the type info:id names, its inputs constants or connections ( <input>.connect ) to other shaders' outputs. class ernie::SkelAnimation Joint transforms and blend shape weights sampled over time. class ernie::StarField Stars from a catalogue as points of light at infinity, behind everything else, each with a black-body spectrum. class ernie::Xform A transform grouping its children. class ernie::Stage A scene's stage metadata, as UsdStage keeps it on its pseudo-root: its units (the up axis, metres and kilograms per unit), its time (time codes and frames per second, the range animation plays over, and the time code it is at) and its default prim. class ernie::AttributeDef One declared attribute of a prim type. class ernie::BindlessHeap Every pass's textures and samplers in one descriptor set (set 1 of every PipelineLayout ), each at an index shaders take from their uniforms: bindless descriptor indexing, so a pass's long-lived textures cost it no binding of its own (bindless.slang declares the arrays). class ernie::BindlessHeap::Slot A slot of the heap, freed when destroyed; move-only. class ernie::BlockEncoder Encodes RGBA8 images into BC blocks away from the CPU, as GpuBlockEncoder does on the GPU: bakes use it for the formats it encodes, the CPU's encoders for the rest. class ernie::BrdfRegistry Reflectance models available to a renderer, keyed by BrdfModel::id . class ernie::CacheKey A cache's 128-bit key for everything an entry depends on: two 64-bit FNV-1a hashes from different starts, each piece length-prefixed. class ernie::FrameImages The images a backend renders one frame of a render product into, by render var name: what RenderVarOutput reads, whatever the backend. class ernie::ChunkedFrameImages The images of a frame of a batch of views that do not fit one set of images (such as more views than an image has layers): consecutive chunks of the views, each its own FrameImages . class ernie::Column One attribute of many prims as rows of one array, as a simulation keeps its bodies' poses: written whole from any array (CPU or CUDA, DLPack, no copy), or mapped and written in place on the device asked for, each write one change ( ColumnChange ) whatever the number of prims. class ernie::ColumnStorage Storage a consumer of columns offers for them on a device it reads them on, such as a renderer's interop buffers: a column mapped there ( Column::Map ) is then written where the consumer reads it, copying nothing. class ernie::ComputeInterop Zero-copy sharing between a Vulkan device and the compute device behind it (CUDA or HIP), so arrays from compute frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, CuPy, Warp, simulators) reach Ernie's buffers, and Ernie's results reach them, without passing through host memory. class ernie::CudaInterop ComputeInterop for the CUDA device behind a Vulkan device. class ernie::ComputePipeline A compute pipeline over a PipelineLayout . class ernie::CubeSphereLod CDLOD terrain over a whole planet: six LodQuadtree height pyramids, one per face of a cube projected onto a sphere of radius Radius() (a quadrilateralized or "cubed" sphere). class ernie::EditHistory Undo and redo for scene edits made through it: attribute sets and clears, prims defined, and prims removed with their descendants. class ernie::FrameUploads Host data bound for device buffers, staged for one frame in flight and copied by that frame's own commands ( Record ), so the host can prepare a frame while the device still runs earlier ones that read the same buffers: the copies wait on the device for that earlier work, in queue order, rather than the host waiting for it. class ernie::GpuBuffer A Vulkan buffer with its memory, allocated through VMA. class ernie::GpuImage A device-local Vulkan image with a view of all its mips and layers, allocated through VMA. class ernie::GpuTimer Times GPU zones ( ERNIE_GPU_ZONE ) for Ernie's profiler ( ernie/util/profiler.h ) with timestamp queries: a zone writes one timestamp where it starts and one where it ends in its command buffer, and Collect hands finished zones to the profiler without waiting for the device, then frees their queries by host reset (Vulkan 1.2's hostQueryReset) some collects later, once their submission has surely completed. class ernie::GradientNoise Perlin's improved gradient noise in three dimensions, its lattice shuffled by a seed, for procedural fields such as volumes' density: smooth, zero at every integer point, and within about [-1, 1]. class ernie::GraphicsPipeline A graphics pipeline for dynamic rendering, with dynamic viewport and scissor and no culling. class ernie::IsdCameraModel What usgscsm's camera models of image support data share, in the body-fixed frame in metres: class ernie::IsdFrame A frame camera from its image support data, its geometry as usgscsm's frame model ( UsgsAstroFrameSensorModel ) computes it ( IsdCameraModel ): the whole image is exposed at once, at the ISD's centre time, from one position and orientation. class ernie::IsdLineScanner A line scanner (pushbroom camera) from its image support data, its geometry as usgscsm's line scanner model ( UsgsAstroLsSensorModel ) computes it ( IsdCameraModel ): line l is exposed around its time ImageTime(l) , a rate's start time plus its seconds per line times (l - its start line + 0.5), through detector line 0. class ernie::IsdPushFrame A push-frame camera (LROC's WAC, MRO's MARCI) from its image support data, its geometry as usgscsm's push-frame model ( UsgsAstroPushFrameSensorModel ) computes it ( IsdCameraModel ): the image is a stack of framelets, each a frame of FrameletLines lines exposed at once. class ernie::LightPatternRegistry Light patterns a renderer can draw, by LightPatternModel::id . class ernie::LodQuadtree Quadtree over a heightfield for continuous distance-dependent level of detail (CDLOD). class ernie::MappedFile A file mapped read-only into memory: its bytes are read from disk as they are first touched, so a file far larger than memory can be read in parts, the operating system keeping what is used. class ernie::RasterSource A raster image read a rectangle at a time, whatever its file: so that planetary mosaics, elevation models and gigapixel photographs larger than memory are baked, resampled and streamed in parts. class ernie::MosaicRaster One raster of a grid of tiles of one size, type and channels, columns to a row, rows top to bottom: a global mosaic too large for one file (Blue Marble's eight 21600 x 21600 tiles). class ernie::PdsImage A PDS3 image read in place from its mapped file: NASA's Planetary Data System's elevation models and mosaics (LOLA's and MOLA's gridded heights among them), their label attached at the file's start or in a .lbl file beside it. class ernie::TiffImage A TIFF or GeoTIFF image read in place from its mapped file: its layout, and rectangles of its samples decoded on demand, so that images larger than memory (planetary mosaics and elevation models, gigapixel photographs) read a part at a time ( RasterSource ). class ernie::OffscreenTarget A colour and depth target for headless rendering, with readback of the colour image. class ernie::OrbitController Interactive orbit control of a CameraParams around a target point in a z-up world, for inspecting terrain. class ernie::Overlay A named layer of debug drawing: lines, shapes, markers and labels in world coordinates or posed under prims ( OverlayStyle::anchor ), and text and panels on the image itself ( Text , Rect ), drawn over the images of render products that ask for it ( tokens::kOverlays ), after the sensor filters, so they never reach observations that do not. class ernie::TileStore Where a virtual texture's resident tiles live on the device: a sparse image's bound tiles ( SparseImage , filtered in hardware) or a pool of pages ( PagePool , paged in software). class ernie::PagePool The software path of virtual textures, for devices without sparse residency and textures larger than the device's images: resident tiles live in pages, the layers of one 2D array image, which shaders find through a page table ( VirtualTexture ) and filter themselves (bilinear within a page, trilinear across two mips). class ernie::SparseImage A 2D image whose memory is bound tile by tile (Vulkan sparse residency), the hardware path of virtual textures: a texture far larger than device memory holds only the tiles in view, and filtering spans tiles in hardware. class ernie::Path Absolute path naming a prim in a Scene , as in USD: / is the root and /World/Sun is the child Sun of /World . class ernie::PipelineLayout A pipeline layout with one push-descriptor set (set 0), the device's bindless heap (set 1, BindlessHeap ) and an optional push-constant block shared by all stages. class ernie::Prim Handle to a prim in a Scene : its path plus the scene, for chained edits. class ernie::PrimSet A fixed list of prims to write rows of one tensor to at once ( Scene::Write ), such as a simulation's bodies every step: the scene looks the prims up the first time and keeps them, looking them up again only after prims are removed or for another scene. class ernie::RasterBake A colour or data raster baked into a DDS file a band of rows at a time, as BakeTexture would bake it whole: for images larger than memory, than JPEG's 65535 limit or than one file (a MosaicRaster ), and to spread a bake over a viewer's frames. class ernie::RefractiveIndex A complex refractive index tabulated at increasing wavelengths (nm), linearly interpolated and constant beyond its ends. class ernie::RenderDelegate A render backend for a Scene , after Hydra's HdRenderDelegate: the rasterizer, and in future ray and path tracers, behind one interface that applications, the GUI viewer and the Python bindings drive without knowing which backend renders. class ernie::RenderVarOutput One render var of one rendered frame, such as LdrColor , named after UsdRender's RenderVar . class ernie::Renderer Ernie's front door for rendering a Scene headless: a GPU and a render backend on it, with no graphics API to set up. class ernie::Sampler An owned VkSampler . class ernie::Scene A lightweight, USD-shaped scene for Ernie: a tree of typed prims named by Path , each holding attributes by USD name, plus change tracking for render delegates. class ernie::ScopedGpuZone An ERNIE_GPU_ZONE for Ernie's profiler: timestamps around the rest of the scope's commands. class ernie::Selection The prims of a type that hold some attributes ( Scene::Select ), as a Fabric query finds the buckets of a type and attributes: found again only once prims of the type come, go, or author or clear an attribute, and kept in one PrimSet meanwhile, so the columns of its attributes stay theirs from step to step. class ernie::SensorFilterRegistry Custom sensor filters a renderer can run, by SensorFilterModel::id . class ernie::ShaderCompiler Compiles Slang modules at run time. class ernie::Spectrum A spectrum tabulated at increasing wavelengths and linearly interpolated between them; constant beyond the first and last samples. class ernie::StepOperation A submitted step: poll or wait for its GPU work, then fetch its outputs. class ernie::Swapchain A presentation swapchain for a window surface, with one "rendered" semaphore per image. class ernie::Targets Relationship targets given to a setter: one target (a Path or its text), stored as a single Path , or a list of them, stored as a list; reads take either. class ernie::TemperatureModelRegistry Temperature models a renderer can run, by TemperatureModel::id . class ernie::Tensor A strided n-dimensional view of typed memory with an optional owner that keeps it alive: Ernie's end of DLPack. class ernie::TextureCache Textures prepared at load kept between runs as DDS files (as RasterDelegate keeps image files' textures encoded to BC7 on the GPU), so that a texture decodes, mips and encodes once until its file, or how it is read, changes. class ernie::Value A scene attribute value: one of the scalar, vector, matrix, token, relationship and small-array types Ernie's schemas use. class ernie::VulkanContext Owns a Vulkan instance, device, graphics and compute queue, and memory allocator. class ernie::WorkerPool A few threads running jobs in the order they come, such as textures decoded while frames render. class ernie::XformPart A part of XformOps , set or not, read as std::optional<T> is ( if (part) , *part ). class ernie::app::Demo A demo: a scene built in the constructor, advanced by Step , drawn by Render and checked by TestFinal , run by DemoRunner in a window, headless or without a viewer. class ernie::app::DemoRunner Runs demos as Newton's examples run: opens the viewer the options ask for (or none), runs a demo until its window closes or it has run its frames, then writes --output , runs its final test and reports the benchmark. class ernie::app::FileDialog A modal file browser drawn with Dear ImGui, which Viewer shows for OpenFileDialog : a folder's contents with an Up button, an editable path and shortcuts to home, the working directory, the root and the folders used recently, a name field, a file type menu and Open (or Save) and Cancel. class ernie::app::Panel A dockable window of the viewer. class ernie::app::FunctionPanel A panel that draws its contents by calling a function. class ernie::app::WidgetPanel A panel of simple widgets described by data rather than ImGui calls, so code without ImGui bindings (Python) can build one. class ernie::app::Timeline The animation's clock, as Omniverse Kit's timeline: plays the scene's time code ( Stage::GetTimeCode ) over the stage's range, from its start time code to its end, in real time or a frame at a time, looping or stopping at the end. class ernie::app::Viewer An interactive window onto an Ernie Scene : a docked viewport rendering the scene with a RenderDelegate (the rasterizer), plus Stage , Property, Render Settings, Sensor, Stats and Log panels. class ernie::app::ViewerLogs What the viewer's logging calls collect ( Viewer::LogScalar , LogArray , LogImage ), after Newton's viewers' log_scalar , log_array and log_image : scalar signals and arrays drawn in the Plots panel, and images each in a panel of its own, as textures the GPU samples where they were written. class ernie::profiler::ScopedZone Times the rest of the enclosing scope as a CPU zone named name while recording. struct ernie::AnimationPose A SkelAnimation 's samples interpolated at a time: empty arrays for those it lacks. struct ernie::AtmosphereModel A spherical shell of constituents around a planet of radius bottomRadius , up to bottomRadius + topAltitude . struct ernie::AtmosphereParams A planet's atmosphere ( AtmosphereParamsOf ): the physical model's settings and where the planet lies. struct ernie::AttributeMeta How an attribute is described and edited. struct ernie::AttributeTraits How the declared C++ type T reads, writes and converts: Read with the fallback (accepting any numeric or vector type an author used, as GetNumber does), Write , and From , a value as T or nullopt when it cannot be one. struct ernie::AttributeTraits< OrArray< T > > struct ernie::AttributeTraits< Path > struct ernie::AttributeTraits< Tensor > Bulk data: reads the written tensor or null (there is no fallback), writes with Scene::Write . struct ernie::AttributeTraits< bool > struct ernie::AttributeTraits< double > struct ernie::AttributeTraits< glm::dmat4 > struct ernie::AttributeTraits< glm::dquat > struct ernie::AttributeTraits< glm::dvec2 > struct ernie::AttributeTraits< glm::dvec3 > struct ernie::AttributeTraits< glm::dvec4 > struct ernie::AttributeTraits< int > struct ernie::AttributeTraits< std::string > struct ernie::AttributeTraits< std::vector< Path > > struct ernie::AttributeTraits< std::vector< float > > struct ernie::AttributeTraits< std::vector< std::string > > struct ernie::BakeOptions How BakeTexture stores a texture. struct ernie::BandedAtmosphere An atmosphere averaged over a camera's spectral bands, ready for rendering. struct ernie::BandedAtmosphere::Refraction A refracted ray traced from radius r (m) at the apparent zenith cosine mu out of the atmosphere, through its spherically layered refractive index ( RefractiveIndex ), by the ray equation d(n t)/ds = grad n with steps of at most step m. struct ernie::BandedConstituent A constituent averaged over a camera's spectral bands. struct ernie::BrdfModel A reflectance model: shader source plus parameter metadata. struct ernie::BrdfParam One scalar parameter of a reflectance model, with what a UI needs to edit it. struct ernie::CahvoreModel A camera calibrated in JPL's CAHV family of models, as Mars rovers' cameras are (their PDS labels' GEOMETRIC_CAMERA_MODEL, JPL's camera model files): CAHV, a linear (pinhole) model; CAHVOR, with radial distortion about an optical axis; and CAHVORE, with a fish-eye term and an entrance pupil that moves along the optical axis with the field angle, so its rays do not meet at one point. struct ernie::CahvoreModel::ErnieCamera The model as Ernie renders it, in the model's frame (camera to frame). struct ernie::CahvoreModel::Ray A projection ray: its origin (C, or for CAHVORE the entrance pupil's position for its field angle) and unit direction. struct ernie::CameraParams A camera's parameters resolved from its Camera prim ( CameraParamsOf ): a physically based pinhole camera for one image, with UsdGeomCamera's pose, projection and exposure attributes, a spectral range, a lens and a sensor. struct ernie::CameraView The raster view of a camera for one frame, derived from a CameraParams by CameraParams::RasterView : what the rasterizer's passes need. struct ernie::Change A prim's changes since a consumer last looked. struct ernie::ChangeCursor A consumer's position in a scene's history; see Scene::Changes . struct ernie::CloudLayersParams A field a volume shades with ( VolumesOf ): a grid of a NanoVDB file, an OpenVDBAsset 's, or of a NanoVDBField 's array ( buffer ). struct ernie::CloudNoise The tileable noise textures procedural cloud layers are carved from (volume.slang's cloudLayersDensity ): a Perlin-Worley shape and a Worley detail, each repeating in all three axes, a local weather map of the layers' coverage and a curl-noise turbulence, both repeating across. struct ernie::CloudTransportOptions struct ernie::CloudTransportShape The canonical transport table's lattice. struct ernie::CloudTransportTable Light transport in a plane-parallel slab of cloud lit from above by a distant source, for each set of scattering orders (2 and more): the radiance at a view point inside it in each direction of travel, and where on the lit face that light entered, its collector. struct ernie::ColorPrimvar The colours a material's diffuse colour reads through a UsdPrimvarReader_float or _float3: the mesh primvar ( primvars:<name> ), one value or three each ( width ), and the reader's fallback where a mesh has none. struct ernie::ColumnChange One attribute of many prims written whole as rows of one tensor ( Scene::Write of a PrimSet again, or Scene::Unmap of it) since a cursor, as Scene::Changes reports it to a consumer that takes the rows whole. struct ernie::ColumnStorage::Rows Rows a consumer offers, and whether they are storage it keeps (mapped again, the same rows) rather than a copy made there for now. struct ernie::ComputeArrayView A Vulkan image seen by a compute API in place, as an opaque array handle (a CUarray for CUDA, a hipArray_t for HIP): read it with that API's texture or surface objects or 2D array copies. struct ernie::Connection The source of a UsdShade connection: a Shader prim and one of its outputs, e.g. struct ernie::Constituent One constituent of an atmosphere: numberDensity particles per m^3 where its profile is 1. struct ernie::CubeSphereRegion Region of space holding one node of a CubeSphereLod : every direction within angle of axis , between radii inner and outer from the body's centre. struct ernie::CylindricalDem A planet's radius on an equirectangular grid, as LOLA's LDEM products (simple cylindrical, true at the equator) and LROC's NAC DTMs (true at a standard parallel) hold it: heights (metres above referenceRadius ; NaN where the product has no data) row by row from the northern, each row from the western sample eastwards, pixelsPerDegree along the meridians and that times cos(standardParallel) along the parallels. struct ernie::DenseNanoVdbLayout Where a DenseNanoVdbTopology 's values go: leaf (a, b, c) of leaves (the shape's 8^3 blocks) starts firstLeaf + ((a leaves.y + b) leaves.z + c) leafBytes into the grid, and voxel (i, j, k)'s float is valuesOffset + 4 ((i & 7) 64 + (j & 7) 8 + (k & 7)) bytes into its leaf. struct ernie::DensityLayer One term of a vertical density profile, relative to the profile's reference density. struct ernie::DensityProfile A vertical density profile: the weighted mean of its layers, so 1 at the ground for exponential and double exponential layers. struct ernie::DescriptorBinding One binding of a pipeline's push-descriptor set (set 0). struct ernie::DescriptorResource What a binding points at when descriptors are pushed. struct ernie::DetailSettings Tiling of the detail albedo and normal textures. struct ernie::Device struct ernie::DiurnalTable Diurnal surface temperatures over latitude, local time, thermal inertia and albedo: PANGU's planetary look-up tables. struct ernie::DomeDirection One of a dome map's regions of about equal energy ( DomeDirectionsOf ), in the map's frame. struct ernie::DomeParams An environment light at infinity (UsdLux DomeLight ) resolved for a frame ( DomeParamsOf ): radiance from every direction, the spectrum radiance (W m^-2 sr^-1 nm^-1 per camera band) times a relative RGB map whose cosine-convolved spherical harmonics are sh . struct ernie::DomeSun A sun found in a dome's map ( ExtractDomeSun ), in the map's frame. struct ernie::DomeSunExtraction The sun of a latitude-longitude dome map ( tokens::kLightTexture layout) and the map without it, for lighting the sun as a shadowed distant light while the dome keeps the rest of the sky. struct ernie::DropletPhaseTable The phase function of a cloud's water droplets in each of a frame's bands, for volumes to read (volume.slang's dropletAt ): Mie scattering by a gamma distribution of droplet radii, its narrow forward peak (within kDropletForwardDegrees ) folded into the extinction as unscattered light. struct ernie::EarthAtmosphereOptions Earth's atmosphere: an isothermal dry-air column, ozone in a tent profile and a haze aerosol. struct ernie::FieldWriteTarget Where a DenseField 's writer ( RenderDelegate::SetFieldWriter ) writes this frame: its (x, y, z) float32 values, z fastest, at device address values , which is offset bytes into buffer (for copies), shape of them. struct ernie::FrameId Where an image sits in the deterministic random streams of sampling.h . struct ernie::FrameImages::LinearVar A render var the frame holds as one linear buffer over every view rather than an image: written by the frame's own submission, in memory a compute API views in place ( BufferMemory::Shared ), texels of format view after view. struct ernie::FrameParams Per-frame parameters of a render, whatever the backend: the camera, the lights, the sensor filters and the frame's place in the random streams. struct ernie::FrameParams::SensorChain Several sensor chains over the one raster image, each writing its own vars (render vars with their own ernie:filters ); empty runs filters for vars . struct ernie::Frustum Six world-space clip planes of a view-projection matrix, for culling axis-aligned boxes. struct ernie::GpuXform A prim posed on the GPU: its transform ops are rows of GPU arrays, one row per prim of one Scene::Write of many paths, so a renderer composes its local transform per instance from the arrays whole, as a PointInstancer 's: translate, then orient, then scale. struct ernie::GraphicsPipelineDesc Shaders and fixed-function state of a graphics pipeline that draws triangle lists without vertex buffers. struct ernie::IesProfile A luminaire's photometric profile from an IES LM-63 file: its luminous intensity in candela over its file's angles ( IesType ), which Sample reads in any direction. struct ernie::IesTilt An IES file's tilt data (TILT=INCLUDE, or a tilt file): how its lamp's output changes as the luminaire tilts, for lamps whose output depends on their burning position (metal halide). struct ernie::Image RGBA image with linear float channels, rows top to bottom. struct ernie::ImageDesc Description of a 2D image or 2D image array. struct ernie::InstanceData Per-instance arrays of a point instancer, as UsdGeomPointInstancer defines them. struct ernie::IsdCameraModel::FrameView A frame of the detector as Ernie renders it: a frame camera of the image's samples by its rows, posed ( camera.transform , camera to body-fixed world) when the frame is exposed, the lens's distortion fitted as Brown-Conrady terms (and scale). struct ernie::IsdLineScanner::Strip A strip of lines image lines from firstLine as Ernie renders it: a pushbroom camera ( CameraParams::pushbroom ) whose rows are those lines, posed from at the strip's first line's start and to at its end (camera to body-fixed world). struct ernie::IsdPushFrame::Framelet Framelet __ framelet (in image order, from the top) as Ernie renders it: a frame camera of the image's samples by FrameletLines lines, posed when it is exposed (camera to body-fixed world), its exposure the ISD's, the lens's distortion fitted as Brown-Conrady terms (and scale). struct ernie::IsdRotation A rotation sampled over time between two NAIF frames, as ALE reads it ( ale::Orientations ): quaternions (w, x, y, z, scalar first) of the time-dependent rotation of vectors from the reference frame into the first of timeDependentFrames , and a constant rotation (row-major, applied to vectors after it) on into the first of constantFrames . struct ernie::IsdSamples States sampled over time: ephemeris times (seconds past J2000, TDB) and a value at each. struct ernie::IsdSensor A camera's image support data (ISD) in the Community Sensor Model's JSON form, as ALE (the USGS Abstraction Layer for Ephemerides) writes it from SPICE kernels for planetary cameras such as LRO's NAC and WAC, MRO's CTX and HiRISE: the image's size and timing, the focal plane's map to detector pixels, the optics, and the spacecraft's and the body's states over the image. struct ernie::JointDualQuaternion A joint's transform as a unit dual quaternion (rotation, then translation) after a 3 by 3 of its scale and shear. struct ernie::LatLongGrid Where a raster in simple cylindrical (equirectangular) projection lies: degrees east of its west edge and north of its north edge, and degrees per pixel across and down (positive). struct ernie::LensModel A lens: its projection, natural vignetting and transmission. struct ernie::LensRayTable A lens given as its rays: unit directions in the camera's frame at every step th sensor pixel corner, ( width / step + 1) by ( height / step + 1) of them row by row from the top left, interpolated between. struct ernie::LightParams A light, resolved for a frame from its prim ( LightParamsOf ). struct ernie::LightParams::Beam A laser's Gaussian beam (Siegman 1986): its 1/e^2 radius at the waist along the light's x and y, its Rayleigh range along each, and the waist's distance along the beam from position , m. struct ernie::LightParams::Beam::Lit One frame of its sequence lit during a span of time, and how much: the light's mean over the span relative to its average power. struct ernie::LightParams::Pose Where a light is: its position , direction and tangent . struct ernie::LightPatternImage A laser's pattern image ( ernie:laser:pattern:image ) as patterns read it: one linear channel, the mean of its colour channels, its rows top to bottom, and its mip levels after it down to 1 x 1, each max(1, size >> n) on a side and averaging the texels above. struct ernie::LightPatternModel A laser's pattern written in Slang: the relative power a laser sends towards each direction, its watts, beam and shadows staying Ernie's. struct ernie::LightPatternParam One parameter of a light pattern, which a LaserLight gives in ernie:laser:pattern:params in this order. struct ernie::LinkCollection One of a light's collections (UsdCollectionAPI with its prims expanded): the whole scene when includeRoot , else nothing, then the prims listed and their descendants in or out, the nearest listed ancestor of a prim deciding. struct ernie::LinkGroups Geometry grouped by the lights that light it and whose shadows it casts, as the rasterizer applies links: each surface carries its group (0, lit and shadowed by every light, for prims no link singles out), and each light a mask of the groups it lights and of those that cast its shadows. struct ernie::LocalTerrain A heightfield of a DEM about one point, in a local frame there: x east, y north and z up, its origin on the reference sphere at the point. struct ernie::LodPatch One square patch of PatchCells() x PatchCells() grid quads whose vertices are 2^level raster cells apart. struct ernie::LodRange Distances from the LOD eye, in world units, over which one level's vertices morph towards the next coarser level's. struct ernie::LogNormalMode One mode of a log-normal particle size distribution: the number of particles per unit ln(r) is Gaussian with median radius medianRadius (m) and standard deviation sigma , and the mode holds relativeNumber particles relative to the other modes. struct ernie::MappedRenderVar A mapped render var: a tensor for Cpu and Gpu , a compute array for GpuArray . struct ernie::MarsAtmosphereOptions Mars's atmosphere: an isothermal CO2 column and suspended dust. struct ernie::MaterialSettings How a surface reflects light: a material's settings. struct ernie::MaterialXShader A MaterialX surface's shading as Slang for Ernie's shading pass: void ernieMaterialX(out float3 color, out float3 transparency) , which evaluates its graph for the pixel being shaded through the functions below (which the shading pass defines before it), with MaterialX's own closures and nodes: struct ernie::MaterialXSource A Material 's MaterialX surface as a document. struct ernie::MaterialXTexture A texture a MaterialX shader samples, by its slot in the material's texture table. struct ernie::MaterialXUniform A value a MaterialX shader reads from its material's uniform buffer. struct ernie::MeasuredReflectance A measured reflectance spectrum Ernie embeds: its id (as a material names it in ernie:reflectance:library ), what was measured, the ECOSTRESS file it comes from, and the spectrum, a fraction from 350 nm (or where its measurement starts) to 2.5 um and for most on into the thermal infrared, 12.5 to 15 um. struct ernie::MeshData Triangle mesh geometry in a mesh's own frame. struct ernie::MeshData::Level A coarser level of detail: count entries of lodIndices from first , at most error (in mesh units) from the full mesh. struct ernie::MeshDataOptions The geometry of the Mesh prim at mesh : points , faceVertexCounts and faceVertexIndices (triangulated as fans), per-vertex normals , and per-vertex primvars:displayColor when it has one colour per point. struct ernie::MeshWriteTarget Where a mesh's writer ( RenderDelegate::SetMeshWriter ) writes this frame: device addresses into the renderer's own buffers, which a shader reads and writes as pointers (Slang's float* ). struct ernie::MieEfficiencies Mie efficiencies of a homogeneous sphere: cross sections over the geometric cross section pi r^2, and the asymmetry parameter g (the mean cosine of the scattering angle). struct ernie::NamedCahvore A named camera model in a frame, as camera model files list them. struct ernie::NanoVdbGrid One sparse grid as NanoVDB lays it out: a buffer the GPU reads in place (PNanoVDB's tree walk), and what Ernie needs of its header. struct ernie::NormalEquations Accumulates the normal equations of a linear least-squares fit, row by row. struct ernie::OrArray An attribute declared as T that also takes an array written in place of its value: colours per vertex for one displayColor , a width per point. struct ernie::OverlayBatch Many overlay items of one kind from arrays on the host or a GPU ( Overlay::Batch ), such as one per world of a batched simulation, or a physics engine's bodies, contacts and particles: the renderer reads the arrays as they are, without copies to the host, and draws each item from them on the GPU. struct ernie::OverlayFont struct ernie::OverlayGlyph One character of the font ( OverlayTextFont ). struct ernie::OverlayHit What a pick of a rendered image found at a pixel ( RenderDelegate::PickOverlay ): the overlay drawing it, and in it a batch's item ( batch the batch, item its index) or a host item ( batch -1, item its OverlayStyle::id ). struct ernie::OverlayItem What every overlay item carries besides its geometry. struct ernie::OverlayNumberFormat How a Numbers batch prints each of its values: prefix , the value with decimals digits after the point, then suffix , in the style's colour and size , over its background . struct ernie::OverlaySegment A line segment of width pixels, dashed every dash pixels ( OverlayStyle::dash ) unless 0. struct ernie::OverlaySprite A rectangle facing the image at a fixed size in pixels, placed by a world point: rect spans (x0, y0) to (x1, y1) pixels from where anchor projects, y down. struct ernie::OverlayStyle How overlay items look. struct ernie::OverlayTriangle A filled triangle. struct ernie::ParticleOptics Mean optical properties per particle of a particle population at one wavelength: scattering and absorption cross sections (m^2) and the phase function at the requested cosines. struct ernie::Pds3Label A PDS3 label's keywords, by name; a keyword inside an OBJECT prefixed with the object's name and a dot ( IMAGE.LINES ). struct ernie::PlanetHeightsOptions How a latitude-longitude raster's samples become heights over a planet ( PlanetHeightsOf ). struct ernie::PlanetSphere The planet an Atmosphere wraps, in world space. struct ernie::PlanetTile A square of a planet's cube-face grid read from a latitude- longitude raster ( PlanetTileOf ), its points row by row. struct ernie::PolarStereographicDem A planet's radius on a polar stereographic grid (spherical, true at the pole), as LOLA's polar LDEM products hold it: heights (metres above referenceRadius ) row by row, mapScale metres a pixel at the pole. struct ernie::Polarizer A camera's linear polarizer ( tokens::kPolarizerType ): none, one in front of the lens at angle (radians from the image's +x towards +y), or a polarization sensor's mosaic of 2 x 2 pixels at 90, 45 / 135, 0 degrees (Sony's IMX250MZR). struct ernie::PrimTypeDef A registered prim type: its name ( Scene::Define 's type), its base, and the attributes it declares itself; abstract ones, such as "Light", are bases only. struct ernie::ProductFrame A rendered frame of a render product: its render targets and how to reach them. struct ernie::PushbroomStrip A pushbroom camera's strip for one frame ( CameraParams::pushbroom ), as its shaders project with it (projection_pushbroom.slang): its rows' poses run from from (the top row's camera position) to to (the bottom row's), turning from fromRotation to toRotation along the great arc. struct ernie::RasterRect A rectangle of a raster's pixels. struct ernie::RasterView Non-owning view of a north-up grid of float samples with square cells: the form in which Ernie takes heightfields and albedo maps. struct ernie::RefinementStencils Each point of a tessellation as a weighted sum of the control points (the limit surface is linear in them), so control points that move, as skinning moves them, refine again by these sums alone: point p is the sum over k in [starts[p], starts[p + 1]) of weights[k] times control point indices[k]. struct ernie::RegolithProperties A regolith's thermophysical properties and its body's sunlight, the Moon's by default: density rising from its surface value to its deep one over an e-folding depth, contact conductivity following the density, radiative conductivity growing with the cube of temperature, and heat capacity a quartic in temperature. struct ernie::RenderDelegate::TimeWindow The span of the clock the next frame covers, from the last frame's end to now, which the frame after starts from. struct ernie::RenderPrims The prims a render of scene uses, as every render delegate resolves them: struct ernie::RenderProductOutput The outputs of one render product in a step: its render vars by name, and the span of the sensor clock its frame covers, seconds ( RenderDelegate::Time ), as ovrtx's frame start and end times. struct ernie::RenderProductSpec A render product to draw, resolved from UsdRender prims. struct ernie::RenderStats What a delegate holds, for statistics panels. struct ernie::RendererInfo What a render backend is and does, so applications, settings panels and bindings can adapt. struct ernie::RendererOptions Options for creating a Renderer . struct ernie::RenderingTarget Attachments of one dynamic-rendering pass. struct ernie::SampleBracket Where time falls among samples at times (increasing, not empty): the samples either side and how far between them, 0 at the lower; one sample (both the same, 0) at or outside the ends and on a sample. struct ernie::SamplerDesc Sampler filtering and addressing. struct ernie::ScreenPlacement Where a screen item ( Overlay::Text , Overlay::Rect ) sits on the image, whatever its size: the point at (fractions of the image's width and height from its top left corner) moved offset pixels (y down), with the item's own point align (fractions of its width and height from its top left) there. struct ernie::SensorChannel One channel of a sensor: its quantum efficiency (electrons per photon) over wavelength. struct ernie::SensorFilterModel A sensor filter written in Slang, run in the fused sensor kernel like the built-in ones: a struct typeName in module slang implementing IBandFilter (kind Band , domain Spectrum ), IPixelFilter (kind Pixel , on one of the other domains), or for kind Spatial , which reads the pixels around its own, ISpatialBandFilter (domain Spectrum ) or ISpatialPixelFilter (the other domains). struct ernie::SensorFilterOutput One output of a sensor filter. struct ernie::SensorFilterParam A custom filter's parameter: a float its prim sets as inputs:<name> , or with size above 1 an array of floats ( float name[size] in the filter's Params , such as a curve; sensor.slang's curveAt reads one), which the prim sets as a float array of any length, resampled linearly to size (a single number fills it). struct ernie::SensorFilterStep One filter of a product's chain: a SensorFilter prim's ernie:filter:type , a built-in's name or a registered filter's id, with the floats of its inputs:* attributes by name (without "inputs:"). struct ernie::SensorModel An image sensor: channels with quantum efficiency curves, full well, noise, gain and ADC. struct ernie::ShaderModuleSource One Slang module given as source text. struct ernie::ShadowSettings Cascaded shadow map options. struct ernie::SigmoidSpectrum A smooth reflectance spectrum in Jakob and Hanika's sigmoid-polynomial form: s(lambda) = 1/2 + x / (2 sqrt(1 + x^2)) with x = c0 t^2 + c1 t + c2 and t the wavelength mapped from 360-830 nm to 0-1. struct ernie::SkeletonPose A Skeleton posed at a time. struct ernie::SkinBinding What binds a Mesh to its Skeleton . struct ernie::SkinBinding::Shape Each blend shape by the name animations weight it: its first sub-shape (its primary; its inbetweens follow) and the inbetweens' weights. struct ernie::SkinBinding::SubShape A blend shape's primary shape or one of its inbetweens. struct ernie::SkinPose A skinned mesh's pose at a time. struct ernie::SparseImageDesc Description of a SparseImage : one 2D layer, sampled. struct ernie::SparseTile A tile of a virtual texture: mip mip 's tile at ( x , y ), counted in tiles from the top left. struct ernie::SpectralBands A wavelength range split into count bands of equal width, the spectral sampling of one camera. struct ernie::Star One star of a StarField , as renders take it: where it is and the black-body spectrum it shines with. struct ernie::StarCatalogue A star catalogue as a StarField 's arrays take it: right ascension and declination in degrees, visual magnitude and B-V colour index per star. struct ernie::StarFieldParams The stars of a StarField prim ( StarsOf ) are uploaded when they change; each frame takes only where the catalogue's frame lies ( StarFieldParamsOf ). struct ernie::SubdivisionSurface A subdivision surface's control mesh and tags, as USD's Mesh holds them. struct ernie::Swapchain::Frame One acquired image, ready to render into after waiting on acquired ; signal rendered when done and pass the frame to Present . struct ernie::TemperatureModel A surface's temperature computed as it renders, written in Slang: what a thermal camera sees of a body whose temperatures follow its lighting, with no solver running beside the renderer (PANGU's approach). struct ernie::TemperatureModelParam One parameter of a temperature model, which a material gives in ernie:thermal:model:params in this order. struct ernie::TextureData A texture as a DDS or KTX2 file stores it, not decoded: each layer's mips of format , mip 0 full size and each next halved (at least 1), with a cube map's six faces as layers. struct ernie::TextureFormatInfo What a TextureFormat stores. struct ernie::TextureReader A texture read through mesh texture coordinates: a UsdUVTexture with the primvar reader and UsdTransform2d feeding it, which is also glTF's textureInfo with KHR_texture_transform and MaterialX's image, texcoord and place2d nodes. struct ernie::TextureWait What RenderDelegate::WaitForTextures left: textures still loading when it timed out, and the errors of those that failed. struct ernie::ThermalSettings Thermal emission ( RenderSettings ' ernie:thermal:* ): whether materials glow at their temperatures, the temperature of those without their own (0, none), and the background's, which the frame's dome carries ( FrameParamsOf adds it to the dome's radiance). struct ernie::TimeSample One time sample of an attribute: a value, or a tensor and the CUDA stream it was written on ( Scene::Write ). struct ernie::TimelinePoint A wait for or a signal of a timeline semaphore value in a submission. struct ernie::TriangleCorners Where each corner of TriangulateFaces ' triangles comes from: its face and its position in faceVertexIndices , for primvars with uniform and faceVarying interpolation. struct ernie::UsdImportOptions struct ernie::UsdImportResult struct ernie::UsdVariantSelection A variant selection made before a USD stage is translated: the variant set set of the USD prim prim set to selection . struct ernie::VolumeFieldParams struct ernie::VolumeMaterialParams How a volume's fields shade: its Material 's volume inputs ( material_schemas.h ), the emission colour times its strength. struct ernie::VolumeParams A Volume ( VolumesOf ): where it is, which world, its material and its density, temperature and emission fields, each optional. struct ernie::VolumeSettings How finely volumes render ( RenderSettings ' ernie:volumes:* ): steps through each volume, towards each light, up and down for the sky's light (0, unoccluded) and through the air in front (0, none), the most orders of multiple scattering, and the texels across the volumes' shadow maps. struct ernie::VulkanContext::ExportedBuffer A Shared buffer's handles, which whichever goes first of the buffer and this context destroys (under mutex ), nulling them: an array a scene still holds over the buffer after its renderer is gone keeps the memory through CUDA's import of it. struct ernie::VulkanContextOptions Options for VulkanContext::Create . struct ernie::XformOps A prim's local transform as translate, rotate (Euler angles or a quaternion) and scale, the ops of USD's UsdGeomXformCommonAPI. struct ernie::app::CaptureNameFields What a capture's file name may name ( ExpandCaptureName ). struct ernie::app::CaptureOptions Where the viewer's captures go ( Viewer::GetCaptureOptions ). struct ernie::app::CreatableType A prim type the viewer's Create menu makes, with its menu label and group, the name new prims take, and the prim they go under unless a group prim is selected. struct ernie::app::CreateContext Where a new prim goes and what it starts from. struct ernie::app::DemoInfo A demo the runner can build, for the Demos panel and DemoMain . struct ernie::app::DemoOptions The options every demo takes ( ParseDemoOptions ), as Newton's examples share theirs. struct ernie::app::DemoRegistration Registers a demo at static initialization, for RegisteredDemos . struct ernie::app::DirectoryEntry One row of a folder listing. struct ernie::app::DockSizes The default layout's docks as fractions of the window: what each takes of the space left once the docks before it are placed (left, then the right column, then the bottom). struct ernie::app::FileDialogOptions What a file dialog asks for ( Viewer::OpenFileDialog ). struct ernie::app::FileFilter A choice of the file dialog's file type menu: a label and the extensions it shows, such as {"Terrain configurations", {".json"}}; no extensions shows every file. struct ernie::app::FrameInfo Per-frame information passed to OnFrame , OnPreRender and OnPostRender callbacks. struct ernie::app::LogEntry One message of the viewer's log ( Viewer::Log ). struct ernie::app::PropertyField One known attribute a panel edits: how to show it, and what Ernie uses when it is not authored. struct ernie::app::PropertySection A titled group of fields, such as a prim type's "Light" or "Shape" attributes. struct ernie::app::SequenceOptions A sequence to record ( Viewer::RecordSequence ). struct ernie::app::Theme Colours (sRGB-encoded with alpha, as written to the screen) and metrics of the viewer's UI: a classic scientific desktop look, as Qt's and GTK's of the 2000s that tools such as PANGU wear (colours read from PANGU v7's renderer GUI): light grey-green windows (#D4D7D0), white sunken fields and raised buttons with one-pixel edges, square corners, black text, a navy accent and pale-blue selection. struct ernie::app::ViewerOptions Options for opening a Viewer . struct ernie::app::ViewportDisplay What the viewport draws over the scene, as Kit's viewport "show by type" menu (the eye) and heads-up display settings choose. struct ernie::memory::Allocation One live allocation. struct ernie::profiler::Frame One frame's zones. struct ernie::profiler::Report The GPU's zones and the CPU's, the latter under a node per thread. struct ernie::profiler::ReportFilter What to list of a report: zones nested at most depth deep (0: the outermost alone) and taking at least minMs , in a tree whose siblings come in the order they ran or, byTime , longest first. struct ernie::profiler::ReportNode A zone's averages over the frames summarized: zones of the same name under the same parent merge. struct ernie::profiler::ReportRow A listed zone and how deep it is shown. struct ernie::profiler::Zone A timed span: a CPU zone of thread thread , or a GPU zone ( thread unused) on the device's own clock. struct ernie::reflectance_table::Entry struct ernie::BindlessHeap::Array struct ernie::BindlessHeap::Held What a slot holds: an image view and its layout, or a sampler. struct ernie::BindlessHeap::HeldHash struct ernie::BindlessHeap::SharedSlot struct ernie::EditHistory::PrimSnapshot One prim of a removed subtree, enough to define it again. struct ernie::EditHistory::Step struct ernie::FrameUploads::Copy struct ernie::FrameUploads::Staging struct ernie::GpuTimer::Pending struct ernie::GpuTimer::Retiring A finished zone's queries, reset once kRetireCollects more collects have passed. struct ernie::Scene::ColumnData Rows of one tensor that many prims' attribute is ( Write of a PrimSet ), written again or unmapped whole in one step. struct ernie::Scene::PrimData struct ernie::Scene::PrimData::Bound Attributes that are rows of a column ( columns_ ): which, its row, and the column's version its tensors last took ( Refresh ), so a column written whole costs its prims nothing until read. struct ernie::Scene::StorageLink SetColumnStorage 's, which copies of the scene do not take. struct ernie::Scene::UniqueId A process-wide unique id that copies and assignments renew. struct ernie::app::ViewerLogs::Array struct ernie::app::ViewerLogs::Scalar struct ernie::detail::ValueTypeOf The type an attribute declared as T holds as a value. struct ernie::detail::ValueTypeOf< OrArray< T > > struct std::hash< ernie::Path >

docs.text: This inheritance list is sorted roughly, but not completely, alphabetically: class ernie::SchemaView Base of the typed views: a handle to one prim of a registered type, read-only when made from a const scene. class ernie::Imageable What every prim has: visibility and the world it is in. class ernie::Atmosphere A planet's atmosphere from a physical model ( EarthAtmosphere , MarsAtmosphere ): its gases and aerosols scatter and absorb the sun's light on its way to the ground, the sun's DistantLight then giving the irradiance above the atmosphere. class ernie::BlendShape Offsets of a mesh's points (and normals), weighted by an animation, with inbetween shapes at weights between 0 and 1. class ernie::Boundable What has local bounds: geometry and instancers, with an optional authored extent. class ernie::Gprim Geometry: drawn in a display colour, or with a bound material. class ernie::AxisShape An implicit shape centred on its origin along one of its axes: a cylinder, cone, capsule or plane. class ernie::Capsule A cylinder with hemispherical caps along its axis. class ernie::Cone A capped cone along its axis, its apex at +height / 2. class ernie::Cylinder A capped cylinder along its axis. class ernie::Plane A one-sided rectangle facing along its axis. class ernie::Cube A box centred on its origin, size along each axis. class ernie::PointBased Geometry from an array of points: a mesh or a point cloud. class ernie::Mesh A polygon mesh: points and the faces over them. class ernie::Points Points drawn as spheres widths across, coloured by their display colour. class ernie::Sphere A sphere centred on its origin. class ernie::Terrain A north-up heightfield (x east, y north, z up) drawn with its bound material, or, with a planet radius, a whole planet of six cube faces ( CubeSphereLod ). class ernie::Volume A participating medium: fields, each named by a relationship field:<name> to a field prim, shaded by the bound Material 's volume inputs (density, albedo, emission, temperature). class ernie::PointInstancer Instances of its prototypes (the prototypes relationship's targets) at rows of positions, orientations and scales. class ernie::SkelRoot The root of a skinned character: the meshes and skeletons under it go together. class ernie::Skeleton Joints in a hierarchy, with the transforms their meshes were bound at and their rest pose, posed by an animation source. class ernie::Camera A camera looking down its -z axis with +y up: UsdGeomCamera's projection, apertures, clipping, exposure and shutter, and Ernie's lens, scan, spectral sampling, sensor and view poses. class ernie::FieldBase A field of values over space, which Volumes name; its transform places the field in its Volume (UsdVol's FieldBase ). class ernie::CloudLayersField Ernie's procedural cloud layers: up to four layers over a repeating weather map, carved from tileable noise at each sample on the GPU (three-geospatial's clouds, after Horizon Zero Dawn's), in the field's frame with z up; a Volume 's density, its material's density scaling it. class ernie::DenseField Ernie's field of a dense array of values, such as a grid solver's smoke or dust each step (Warp's arrays): sampled as a NanoVDB grid of every voxel, which a device array fills in place on the GPU. class ernie::FieldAsset A field read from a file (UsdVol's FieldAsset ). class
